subchannels.synthesis: Bag, generic vessel, lot-container, fitted box or socket, heat cloth, mouth corners, udder or fruit cover, and water basin all depend on enclosure. Each controls a different content, but the operation remains gathering within a bounded, accessible form.

subchannels.name: Weaving, joining, and crosswise reinforcement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flexible or segmented material is joined into a surface that can bear use.
subchannels.active_motifs: إحكام رصين في نسج أو كلام (`quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`); إحكام النسج (`quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`); أجزاء موصولة يقابل بعضها بعضا (`quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`); قطعة منشقة وثوب (`quranic:root_000807:B006/m01`); الشيء الموضوع عرضا أو المعترض عرضيا (`quranic:root_001001:B013/m01`); ما يستر أو يستتر (`quranic:root_000428:B002/m01`); الإراض البساط الضخم (`quranic:root_000025:B005/m01`); أداة الحمل ومركوبه (`quranic:root_000357:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Tight weave, joined straps, a cut piece of cloth, crossbeam, covering layer, heavy rug, and transport fittings move from thread-scale joining to load-bearing textile. Their quality is measured by firmness, fit, and whether the surface continues to cover.

subchannels.name: Wood, cutting edge, and shaped support
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wood is selected, stripped, cut, polished, and raised as tool or frame.
subchannels.active_motifs: عود من خشب وطيب وآلة (`quranic:root_001058:B010/m01`); قراع صلب ممسوح (`quranic:root_001219:B011/m01`); غصن ساقط أو يابس يتخذ منه (`quranic:root_000859:B007/m01`); السقف والمظلّة المرفوعة (`quranic:root_001000:B002/m01`); تعريش الكرم والعنب (`quranic:root_001000:B003/m01`); خشب البئر وموضع الساقي (`quranic:root_001000:B004/m01`); قطع حاسم (`quranic:root_000322:B001/m01`); الدق والهدم حتى التسوية (`quranic:root_000482:B001/m01`); تصفية الدقيق بالمنخل (`quranic:root_001483:B002/m01`); حد الحديد وبرى الحجر (`quranic:root_001675:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Stick, hard stripped shield or rod, fallen dry branch, roof timber, vine trellis, well frame, decisive cutting, pounding, sieving, and sharpening stone form a wood-and-edge working scene. Destruction and construction use many of the same operations but reverse their purpose.

subchannels.name: Form, silhouette, and represented body
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing is apprehended or reproduced by outline, proportion, and recognizable configuration.
subchannels.active_motifs: الميل والإمالة إلى جهة (`quranic:root_000891:B001/m01`); الصورة والهيئة المصورة (`quranic:root_000891:B003/m01`); جماعة النخل وما يشبهها (`quranic:root_000891:B005/m01`); قطيع البقر (`quranic:root_000891:B006/m01`); حكة الرأس (`quranic:root_000891:B008/m01`); صماغا الفم (`quranic:root_000891:B010/m01`); مرأى ومنظر ومرآة (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); راية منصوبة (`quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`); قامة وقوام الجسم والطول (`quranic:root_001273:B011/m01`); آلة قائمة وجزء قائم (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); غلظ الخلقة والجسم (`quranic:root_000217:B003/m01`); خلقة مطبوعة (`quranic:root_000217:B004/m01`); العرض خلاف الطول والجانب (`quranic:root_001001:B001/m01`); إحداث الشيء وصنعه (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); تصيير الشيء على حال (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); الشروع في الفعل أو ملازمته (`quranic:root_000248:B004/m01`); قصر مع سمن ولجاج (`quranic:root_000248:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Tilted body, created image, palm cluster, cattle herd, scalp-mark, mouth corners, mirror-view, raised standard, stature, standing component, thick constitution, short stout stubborn profile, disposition, breadth, making, transformation, and entry into sustained action all encode form. The scene moves between natural body, manufactured image, and the process that gives either a recognizable state.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Making consists of containing, joining, cutting, fitting, and forming materials for practical use.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:11's vessel, 69:13's horn, 69:16's torn sky, and 69:17's throne activate a dense material-craft layer.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same operations make a bag, quiver, garment, trellis, well frame, polished stick, image, and repaired bone.

parent_channels.name: P2: The record passes from custody to public reading

subchannels.name: Delivery, taking, and displayed possession
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authorized object is brought, given, taken into the hand, and shown to others.
subchannels.active_motifs: الإتيان والمجيء (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); الإيتاء والإعطاء (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); مأتى الأمر وتهيؤه (`quranic:root_000009:B003/m01`); نَفاذ الرجل (`quranic:root_000009:B013/m01`); ها للمناولة والأخذ (`quranic:root_001573:B001/m01`); ها للتنبيه والافتتاح (`quranic:root_001573:B002/m01`); حوز الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); توافي شيئين متقابلين (`quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`); تلقي الكلام أخذا وتلقينا (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`); نظم الحروف واسم المكتوب (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); إخراج القول بالنطق (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ت ي`: 69:19 (أُوتِىَ), 69:25 (أُوتِىَ/أُوتَ); `ه ا ء`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ء خ ذ`: 69:30 (خُذُ); `ل ق ي`: 69:20 (مُلَٰقٍ); `ك ت ب`: 69:19 (كِتَٰبَ/كِتَٰبِ), 69:25 (كِتَٰبَ/كِتَٰبِيَ); `ق و ل`: 69:19 (يَقُولُ), 69:25 (يَقُولُ)
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival and giving culminate in the deictic act 'take': an object becomes present, transferable, and possessed. Encounter and verbal reception turn physical delivery into learned content; written record and spoken statement make the possession publicly legible. The `ه ا ء` motifs are branch-attested but have no available surface-root anchor.

subchannels.name: Joined sheet, written text, and gathered recitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate marks and materials are joined into a text, then gathered again in ordered vocal reading.
subchannels.active_motifs: ضم شيء إلى شيء (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); نظم الحروف واسم المكتوب (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); جمع واجتماع (`quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`); قراءة وتلاوة وإقراء (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); قارئ ناسك متفقه (`quranic:root_001210:B006/m01`); طريقة ومثال وقصد (`quranic:root_001210:B011/m01`); جمع اللفظ وقراءته (`quranic:root_001211:B001/m01`); مثال الشعر وطريقته (`quranic:root_001211:B005/m01`); إبلاغ السلام بصيغته (`quranic:root_001211:B006/m01`); اللسان آلة القول (`quranic:root_001272:B002/m01`); كثرة القول في صاحبه (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); القول الفاشي بين الناس (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); المقاولة في الأمر (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Joining leather and assembling cavalry supply the material root of the book; ordered letters produce the written object. Reading gathers its units into recitation, study, and a practiced way, while tongue, fluent speaker, circulating report, and negotiation specify the social performance through which the text is heard.

subchannels.name: Account, inquiry, and anticipated encounter
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person estimates the coming reckoning, seeks information, and finally meets the measured outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: العد والحساب (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); الحسبان والظن (`quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`); الحسبة والنظر في الأمر (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); التحسب والاستخبار (`quranic:root_000318:B010/m01`); يقين بعد أمارة (`quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`); شك وتوهم (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); أمر لا يوثق بعاقبته (`quranic:root_000969:B006/m01`); الدراية والعلم (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); توافي شيئين متقابلين (`quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`); ما يلقاه المرء من خير أو شر (`quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Counting, estimation, practical review, and inquiry constitute the account. Strong conviction and weak conjecture are separated by whether the outcome can be trusted; knowledge names that epistemic threshold, and encounter turns prediction into the actual good or harm one receives.

subchannels.name: Right-hand allocation and left-hand deprivation
subchannels.scene_or_process: The side of reception allocates blessing, force, or loss before the record is read.
subchannels.active_motifs: اليمن والبركة (`quranic:root_001698:B001/m01`); اليد اليمنى والجهة اليمنى (`quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`); يمين القوة والحق (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); التيمن الموت (`quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`); إحاطة واشتمال من الجوانب (`quranic:root_000819:B001/m01`); جهة الشمال خلاف اليمين (`quranic:root_000819:B006/m01`); الشمال موضع شؤم أو خساسة (`quranic:root_000819:B013/m01`); الإيتاء والإعطاء (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); إثبات يوجب حكما أو قدرا (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); إدخال الاسم في سجل أو زمرة (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The right side carries blessing and effective power but also the mortal posture of being laid on one's right. The left encloses from the opposite side and bears a lexical association with failed fortune; the record itself is a binding decree and official enrollment, so handedness visibly assigns the recipient's place within it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment is staged as a transfer chain: a record arrives, is placed in a hand, opened to speech, received by an audience, and understood as one's own account.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:19-20 and 69:25-26 repeat the giving of the book, the right or left hand, the call to read, and knowledge or ignorance of the account.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The book is simultaneously joined material, written text, binding decree, official register, and an emancipation contract whose terms determine freedom.

parent_channels.name: P2: Accounting becomes settlement of rights and wealth

subchannels.name: Decree, registration, debt, and completed payment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A right is entered, adjudicated, and discharged through an enforceable record.
subchannels.active_motifs: إثبات يوجب حكما أو قدرا (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); إدخال الاسم في سجل أو زمرة (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`); مكاتبة العبد على عتقه (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`); العد والحساب (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); الحسبة والنظر في الأمر (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); الحكم والأمر القاطع (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); الإبلاغ والوصية القاطعة (`quranic:root_001237:B002/m01`); إحكام الصنع وإنفاذ الفعل (`quranic:root_001237:B005/m01`); أداء الحق واستيفاؤه (`quranic:root_001237:B006/m01`); المال المقدم (`quranic:root_000733:B005/m01`); الإتاوة المؤداة (`quranic:root_000009:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The document fixes judgment, enrolls a name, or schedules emancipation payments. Counting and public oversight support adjudication; notification, crafted decree, debt settlement, an advance, and tribute complete the legal-economic circuit from entry to discharge.

subchannels.name: Capital, income, and the limit of sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property is acquired and produces income, yet is tested by whether it actually suffices or substitutes for the person.
subchannels.active_motifs: اتخاذ المال وكثرته (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); الغنى والاستغناء (`quranic:root_001110:B001/m01`); الغَناء والكفاية (`quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`); الغنى بالمكان (`quranic:root_001110:B004/m01`); الكفاية والإغناء (`quranic:root_000318:B003/m01`); الحسب والمآثر (`quranic:root_000318:B004/m01`); دخل يخرج من أصل ثابت (`quranic:root_001102:B011/m01`); استهلاك المال وأخذه (`quranic:root_000043:B004/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Accumulated wealth, independence, adequacy, settled estates, inherited reputation, and property income define resources that appear durable. Consumption or seizure of others' property and provision as a source of livelihood test the moral quality of that wealth; the decisive question is whether any of it can stand in for the owner.

subchannels.name: Authority, proof, and sharp public power
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rule depends on coercive capacity, a prevailing proof, delegated office, and a tongue able to impose its claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: السلاطة قوة قاهرة مسلطة (`quranic:root_000732:B001/m01`); السلطان حجة قاهرة (`quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`); السلطان قدرة وولاية (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); لسان سليط حاد صخاب (`quranic:root_000732:B004/m01`); حدة وطول في الآلة والعضو (`quranic:root_000732:B006/m01`); القيل صاحب القول النافذ (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m01`); اقتالة الحكم على غيره (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); الحكم والأمر القاطع (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); الحسب والمآثر (`quranic:root_000318:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Coercion, demonstrative proof, delegated rule, sharp speech, and hard elongated instruments materialize 'authority.' The authoritative speaker and imposed decision show power becoming discourse, while inherited standing reveals the social capital that vanishes with the condemned person's dominion.

subchannels.name: Marriage, alliance, and economic self-sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Households join through contract and mutual relation, promising social and material sufficiency.
subchannels.active_motifs: مكاتبة العبد على عتقه (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`); أداء الحق واستيفاؤه (`quranic:root_001237:B006/m01`); سلف المصاهرة (`quranic:root_000733:B006/m01`); الغانية المستغنية (`quranic:root_001110:B005/m01`); الغنى والتزويج (`quranic:root_001110:B006/m01`); ائتلاف الشمل بعد تفرق (`quranic:root_000819:B002/m01`); المراضاة والتراضي رضا متبادل (`quranic:root_000569:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Emancipation contract and paid right provide a legal template; intermarried in-laws, the self-sufficient married woman, marriage as protection from need, reunited household, and mutual satisfaction provide the social result. Settlement is therefore also the making or unmaking of durable relations.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Calculation issues in a binding settlement involving debt, obligation, property, authority, and the sufficiency or failure of accumulated means.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:20 and 69:26 name the account, while 69:28-29 explicitly deny the utility of wealth and announce the loss of authority.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The failed wealth scene reaches loan contracts, tribute, appraised reputation, marriage as sufficiency, land revenue, and a slave's staged payments toward release.

parent_channels.name: P2: The garden lowers its harvest to the eater

subchannels.name: Sheltering orchard and dense growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Interlaced vegetation creates a covered garden whose density both conceals and sustains.
subchannels.active_motifs: الستر والاستتار (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); غشيان الليل (`quranic:root_000266:B002/m01`); البستان المستور بالشجر (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); التفاف النبات واندفاعه (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); المَجَنَّة موضع الاستتار (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); أرض ونبت ريان (`quranic:root_000783:B014/m01`); إدراك الثمر وأخذ الطعم (`quranic:root_000934:B005/m01`); غلة الشجر والزرع (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cover, night-like enclosure, tree garden, dense growth, and a place of shelter make the orchard an inhabited canopy. Moist wooded ground, ripening fruit, and crop yield supply its productive interior, so concealment is life-supporting rather than evasive.

subchannels.name: Ripening, cutting, and gathered cluster
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fruit reaches its time, is cut from its stem, and remains as an accessible cluster or usable remainder.
subchannels.active_motifs: أخذ الشيء بقطعه من أصله (`quranic:root_001241:B001/m01`); الثمر المقطوف والعنقود الداني (`quranic:root_001241:B002/m01`); دنو القِطاف وحلول وقته (`quranic:root_001241:B003/m01`); ما يسقط من القِطاف (`quranic:root_001241:B004/m01`); نبات رخص عريض الورق (`quranic:root_001241:B008/m01`); غلة الشجر والزرع (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); إدراك الثمر وأخذ الطعم (`quranic:root_000934:B005/m01`); إطعام الغصن وقبول الوصل (`quranic:root_000934:B010/m01`); خروج النماء والنتاج (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); السلافة والخلاصة الأولى (`quranic:root_000733:B002/m01`); أكل القضى من عجم الزبيب (`quranic:root_001237:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cut fruit, the cluster itself, harvest time, dropped gleanings, edible leafy plant, crop yield, ripened produce, accepted graft, emerging return, first pressed liquid, and eaten raisin pits trace a harvest from plant to gathered food and residue. Cutting here realizes maturity rather than destruction.

subchannels.name: Height that bends into nearness
subchannels.scene_or_process: An elevated setting places its usable upper growth within reach of the eater.
subchannels.active_motifs: السمو والارتفاع (`quranic:root_001042:B001/m01`); الرفعة والشرف (`quranic:root_001042:B002/m01`); الجهة العليا ومن فوق (`quranic:root_001042:B005/m01`); الشيء المحمول على الأعلى (`quranic:root_001042:B008/m01`); الطول والضخامة (`quranic:root_001042:B010/m01`); القرب والمقاربة (`quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`); الدنيا والأدنى (`quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`); دنو الأعلى من الوسط (`quranic:root_000493:B005/m01`); الثمر المقطوف والعنقود الداني (`quranic:root_001241:B002/m01`); مشي الدابة المتقارب البطيء (`quranic:root_001241:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Height, honor, upper side, top-load, and tall bodily form establish vertical abundance. Nearness, the lower world as what is close, and a bent upper body reverse distance; the slow close-stepping animal gives the same geometry motion, and the low cluster becomes the point where height meets hand.

subchannels.name: Past advance becomes present yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earlier action is stored like seed, capital, or first provision and returns as consumable produce.
subchannels.active_motifs: التقدم والسبق (`quranic:root_000733:B001/m01`); السلفة قبل الطعام (`quranic:root_000733:B003/m01`); المال المقدم (`quranic:root_000733:B005/m01`); الأرض المسلوفة (`quranic:root_000733:B010/m01`); خروج النماء والنتاج (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); غلة الشجر والزرع (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); النصيب والرزق المطعوم (`quranic:root_000043:B003/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`); إدراك الثمر وأخذ الطعم (`quranic:root_000934:B005/m01`); مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن (`quranic:root_000436:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: What went before includes prior deed, advance meal, invested capital, and leveled seedbed. Its return appears as crop, allotted food, livelihood, and ripeness; elapsed generations give the causal sequence temporal depth. Reward is thus materialized as a yield whose conditions were laid down earlier.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Cultivation joins sheltering growth, vertical abundance, ripened fruit, timely cutting, and bodily access.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:22-24 locates the rewarded person in a high garden with low-hanging clusters and commands eating and drinking.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Elevation is reversed into service: the high place does not distance its produce but bends it close, while past action appears as seed, advance, and first-flowing yield.

parent_channels.name: P2: Hospitality joins appetite, vessel, and ease

subchannels.name: Meal, drink, portion, and shared company
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food and liquid are taken in assigned shares by an eating and drinking company.
subchannels.active_motifs: تناول المطعوم (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`); النصيب والرزق المطعوم (`quranic:root_000043:B003/m01`); وعاء الأكل وموضعه (`quranic:root_000043:B013/m01`); تناول المائع (`quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`); نصيب الماء (`quranic:root_000783:B002/m01`); جماعة الشرب والمشارب (`quranic:root_000783:B003/m01`); موضع الشرب وآلته (`quranic:root_000783:B004/m01`); ذوق الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`); إطعام الغير وطلب الطعام (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`); السلفة قبل الطعام (`quranic:root_000733:B003/m01`); هناءة بلا مشقة ولا وخامة (`quranic:root_001604:B001/m01`); الهنء عطاء وكفاية (`quranic:root_001604:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Eating, allotted livelihood, bowl, drinking, water-share, drinking group, room or vessel, taste, feeding, livelihood, first course, effortless digestion, and ample gift form the full hospitality frame. The meal is social because shares, servers, and companions are built into its lexical structure.

subchannels.name: Vessel preparation and controlled pouring
subchannels.scene_or_process: Containers are lined, sealed, seasoned, and fitted so food or liquid can be served without loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: موضع الشرب وآلته (`quranic:root_000783:B004/m01`); تطييب القربة وتشريبها (`quranic:root_000783:B013/m01`); وعاء الأكل وموضعه (`quranic:root_000043:B013/m01`); السلف الجراب (`quranic:root_000733:B008/m01`); السلفة بطانة الخف (`quranic:root_000733:B013/m01`); خرقة تحبس صب الماء (`quranic:root_001102:B008/m01`); نوى مخلوط بالعلف (`quranic:root_001102:B010/m01`); موضع الاغتسال وآلة التسخين (`quranic:root_000001:B013/m01`); السلاسة في الجري والشرب (`quranic:root_000731:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Drinking chamber or cup, seasoned waterskin, eating vessel, large bag, shoe-lining as a thin inner layer, spout filter, feed mixed with date stones, bath vessel, and smooth-flowing drink specify preparation at the container boundary. Taste and flow depend on what lines, seals, filters, and holds the contents.

subchannels.name: Ease, approval, and congratulated well-being
subchannels.scene_or_process: A beneficial provision is accepted without aversion and acknowledged as a good state.
subchannels.active_motifs: هناءة بلا مشقة ولا وخامة (`quranic:root_001604:B001/m01`); الهنء عطاء وكفاية (`quranic:root_001604:B002/m01`); هناءة الماشية من النبت (`quranic:root_001604:B003/m01`); تهنئة بخير وولاية (`quranic:root_001604:B005/m01`); الرضا خلاف السخط (`quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`); الرضوان والمرضاة اسم للرضا الكثير أو المطلوب (`quranic:root_000569:B002/m01`); المراضاة والتراضي رضا متبادل (`quranic:root_000569:B003/m01`); الإرضاء طلب رضا الغير وإزالة سخطه (`quranic:root_000569:B004/m01`); الرِّضا خلاف السخط والقبول (`quranic:root_000570:B001/m01`); الكفاية والإغناء (`quranic:root_000318:B003/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ه ن ء`: 69:24 (هَنِيٓـًٔۢا); `ر ض و`: 69:21 (رَّاضِيَةٍ); `ر ض ي`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ح س ب`: 69:20 (حِسَابِ), 69:26 (حِسَابِ)
subchannels.synthesis: Wholesome ease, adequate gift, pasture share, congratulation, acceptance, abundant satisfaction, mutual approval, active pleasing, and sufficiency describe well-being as both bodily and relational. The `ر ض ي` acceptance motif is lexically available but has no surface-root anchor.

subchannels.name: Animal care at the edge of the feast
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pasture, drink, coating, and fatness maintain the animals whose products support human provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: هناءة الماشية من النبت (`quranic:root_001604:B003/m01`); الهِناء قطران يطلى به البعير (`quranic:root_001604:B004/m01`); سمن الحيوان وطعم الشحم (`quranic:root_000934:B007/m01`); مستطعم الفرس وطلب جريه (`quranic:root_000934:B009/m01`); نصيب الماء (`quranic:root_000783:B002/m01`); أرض ونبت ريان (`quranic:root_000783:B014/m01`); كرائم المال والإبل (`quranic:root_000001:B014/m01`); السبع الحيوان المفترس (`quranic:root_000669:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Animals receive plant share, protective tar, body fat, induced running, allotted water, lush ground, and the status of choice stock; predation defines the risk at the boundary. Hospitality rests on an attended pastoral resource, not food appearing without material support.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A complete meal requires food and drink, allotted shares, serving vessels, bodily reception, and freedom from harmful aftermath.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:24 commands eating and drinking in ease, while 69:34-37 inverts hospitality into withheld or corrupt food.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The table extends into pre-meal provision, a drinker's cohort, a sealed waterskin, congrats at good fortune, pasture for animals, and the social economy that sustains guests.

parent_channels.name: P2: Handedness organizes enclosure and omen

subchannels.name: Right side, oath, blessing, and effective force
subchannels.scene_or_process: The right hand receives, pledges, and acts from a culturally favored side.
subchannels.active_motifs: اليمن والبركة (`quranic:root_001698:B001/m01`); اليد اليمنى والجهة اليمنى (`quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`); يمين الحلف (`quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`); يمين القوة والحق (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); اليمن البلد والانتساب (`quranic:root_001698:B005/m01`); التيمن الموت (`quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`); الإيتاء والإعطاء (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); حوز الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Blessing, right hand, oath, force, geographic rightwardness, and mortal right-side posture gather around receiving and taking. Giving and possession complete the hand-to-hand transfer; the favored side is simultaneously bodily, juridical, and agentive.

subchannels.name: Left side, cold current, and failed lot
subchannels.scene_or_process: The opposite hand marks spatial contrast and carries associations of cold exposure and unfavorable assignment.
subchannels.active_motifs: جهة الشمال خلاف اليمين (`quranic:root_000819:B006/m01`); ريح الشمال وما تبرده (`quranic:root_000819:B007/m01`); الشمول خمرا باردة أو مغطية للعقل (`quranic:root_000819:B009/m01`); الشمال موضع شؤم أو خساسة (`quranic:root_000819:B013/m01`); اليد اليمنى والجهة اليمنى (`quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`); حمحمة الفرس (`quranic:root_000001:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Left hand and north wind establish side and temperature; cold wine overlays the mind, ominous bird or left-hand lot marks failed fortune, and an animal's low vocalization supplies the tense soundscape. The contrast is not a claim that every left sense is punitive, but a local convergence around adverse allocation.

subchannels.name: Wrapping, encompassing, and concealed load
subchannels.scene_or_process: A side-cloth closes around body or object and may hide what is being carried.
subchannels.active_motifs: إحاطة واشتمال من الجوانب (`quranic:root_000819:B001/m01`); لف الثوب واشتماله (`quranic:root_000819:B003/m01`); شد وعاء يشتمل على الحيوان أو النخلة (`quranic:root_000819:B004/m01`); حمل مستور في الاشتمال (`quranic:root_000819:B005/m01`); الستر والاستتار (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); الجُنّة الواقية (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); غلالة بين الثياب (`quranic:root_001102:B007/m01`); القطيفة ذات الخمل وما يشبهها (`quranic:root_001241:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Encompassing, cloak, tied udder or fruit cover, hidden short sword or stolen animal, generic concealment, shield, undergarment, and plush covering make sidedness into an enclosing textile operation. What the hand receives may be displayed, but what the garment holds can remain unseen.

subchannels.name: Reunited group and inherited disposition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Scattered persons are gathered into one social whole with recognizable habits and rank.
subchannels.active_motifs: ائتلاف الشمل بعد تفرق (`quranic:root_000819:B002/m01`); شمائل الإنسان وخلائقه (`quranic:root_000819:B008/m01`); الشمال موضع شؤم أو خساسة (`quranic:root_000819:B013/m01`); سواد الناس وجماعتهم (`quranic:root_000266:B013/m01`); المراضاة والتراضي رضا متبادل (`quranic:root_000569:B003/m01`); الرضي صفة للمطيع أو المحب أو الضامن (`quranic:root_000569:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Reunited company, personal dispositions, unfavorable status, mass of people, mutual approval, and the obedient or guaranteeing associate describe the social 'side' to which one belongs. Cohesion is ethical as well as numerical.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Right and left are not mere coordinates: they distribute blessing, force, enclosure, social cohesion, cold, and ominous rank.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:19 and 69:25 contrast the right and left hands as the first visible division between outcomes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A side becomes a garment, wind, covered weapon, herd-binding device, and social 'gatheredness,' giving handed judgment a full material frame.

parent_channels.name: P2: Seizure becomes linked confinement

subchannels.name: Taking, arrest, and bodily grip
subchannels.scene_or_process: Agents seize the condemned person by an available hold and convert mobility into custody.
subchannels.active_motifs: حوز الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); المؤاخذة بالذنب (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); القبض والأسر (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); رقية تمسك وتحبس (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); أخذة المصارعة (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); مقبض الشيء المأخوذ به (`quranic:root_000018:B012/m01`); الذراع جارحة ممدودة (`quranic:root_000512:B001/m01`); الأخذ بالذراع وتذريعه (`quranic:root_000512:B007/m01`); فعل سبعة: المبالغة في الأخذ والشر (`quranic:root_000669:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Taking, accountability, arrest, binding charm, wrestling hold, handle, extended arm, arm-grip or choke, and exemplary harsh seizure form a capture sequence. The body is controlled first at the interface where hand meets limb.

subchannels.name: Collar, hidden insertion, and fixed restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A device enters around or through the body and remains fixed in its interstices.
subchannels.active_motifs: دخول ثابت في الخلال (`quranic:root_001102:B001/m01`); طوق يغل العضو (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); إدخال الحبل في العنق (`quranic:root_000783:B008/m01`); الأخذ بالذراع وتذريعه (`quranic:root_000512:B007/m01`); إسكان الذبيحة بالسكين (`quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`); شد وعاء يشتمل على الحيوان أو النخلة (`quranic:root_000819:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Penetration between parts, iron collar, rope through neck, arm restraint, slaughtering blade that stills movement, and tied animal-cover all share the operation of fastening a living body. The punishment intensifies familiar husbandry and tool functions into immobilization.

subchannels.name: Threading through linked material
subchannels.scene_or_process: A line of connected parts receives another body or material through its continuous path.
subchannels.active_motifs: اتصال الحلقات والأجزاء (`quranic:root_000731:B002/m01`); امتداد ملتف متعاقب (`quranic:root_000731:B003/m01`); تردد واضطراب متتابع (`quranic:root_000731:B004/m01`); النفاذ في الطريق (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`); إدخال الشيء في الشيء (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); الخيط الذي يخاط به (`quranic:root_000735:B004/m01`); طرة ممتدة في ناحية الثوب (`quranic:root_000735:B005/m01`); دخول ثابت في الخلال (`quranic:root_001102:B001/m01`); سير أو رسالة تتخلل البلاد (`quranic:root_001102:B009/m01`); ضم شيء إلى شيء (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Iron links, a winding chain-like extension, repeated disturbance, road penetration, insertion, sewing thread, extended selvedge, deep entry, traveling message, and joined material all define serial continuity. 'Insert him' is thereby rendered as threading a body through a made line.

subchannels.name: Measured span, capacity, and exceeded limit
subchannels.scene_or_process: The restraint is quantified by bodily measure and tested against the prisoner's power to endure or traverse it.
subchannels.active_motifs: القياس بالذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B002/m01`); امتداد الخطو والسعي (`quranic:root_000512:B003/m01`); الذرع طاقة ومدى (`quranic:root_000512:B004/m01`); النواحي ومشارف العمران (`quranic:root_000512:B008/m01`); على حبل الذراع حاضر (`quranic:root_000512:B009/m01`); خفيف اليد في العمل (`quranic:root_000512:B010/m01`); أعلام وأجزاء تسمى بالذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B013/m01`); العدد سبعة وما يتفرع منه (`quranic:root_000669:B001/m01`); اتصال الحلقات والأجزاء (`quranic:root_000731:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cubit-measure, extended stride, capacity, borderlands, immediate availability, skilled hand, named arm-lengths, seventy, and linked iron place the chain in a measurable spatial world. The number exceeds ordinary bodily reach, turning measurement into a declaration of inescapability.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Punitive control proceeds from taking the body to fixing a collar, joining links, threading the prisoner through, and measuring the completed restraint.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:30-32 orders seizure, fettering, burning, and insertion into a seventy-cubit chain.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The mechanism reaches wrestling grip, amulet-like arrest, bridle, sewing thread, linked lightning, arm-span, chokehold, and the amount of force a body can bear.

parent_channels.name: P2: Fire and washing are inverted into forced intake

subchannels.name: Blaze, roasting, and furnace-like correction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire is fed, intensified, entered, and used to roast or straighten material.
subchannels.active_motifs: تأجج النار وشدة حرها (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`); احتدام الحرب والموت (`quranic:root_000225:B002/m01`); تلهب الوجه بالغضب (`quranic:root_000225:B004/m01`); ملاقاة النار وحرها (`quranic:root_000880:B003/m01`); إيقاد الصلاء وتسوية الشيء بالنار (`quranic:root_000880:B004/m01`); الصلاية حجر يدق عليه (`quranic:root_000880:B009/m01`); إطعام النار واشتعالها (`quranic:root_000043:B005/m01`); السواد والفحم والدخان (`quranic:root_000001:B001/m01`); ذوبان الإهالة والشحم (`quranic:root_000001:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Blazing coals, battle-like heat, inflamed face, entering fire, kindling, roasting, heating a rod straight, grinding stone, fire consuming fuel, black smoke, and melted fat create a furnace process. The condemned body occupies the place of both material and fuel.

subchannels.name: Hot liquid, sweat, fever, and inward thirst
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat enters water and body, producing sweat, fever, unresolved thirst, and the nearness of death.
subchannels.active_motifs: الماء الحار والاغتسال به (`quranic:root_000001:B002/m01`); العرق وأثر الحر (`quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`); الحمى والحمام في الأبدان والأرض (`quranic:root_000001:B005/m01`); دنو الأمر وحضوره (`quranic:root_000001:B006/m01`); القضاء والقدر والموت (`quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`); حرارة تنغل في الجوف (`quranic:root_001102:B002/m01`); ماء يشرب مع كراهة (`quranic:root_000783:B005/m01`); السلاط غليل (`quranic:root_000732:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Scalding water, hot spring, sweat, fever, due time, decreed death, inward burning thirst, bitter drink, and raw craving track heat from environment into physiology. What would ordinarily cool and satisfy becomes another carrier of torment.

subchannels.name: Washing medium turned corrupt food
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material associated with cleaning, runoff, or filtration is presented as the only available nourishment.
subchannels.active_motifs: تطهير الشيء بإسالة الماء وإزالة الدرن (`quranic:root_001087:B001/m01`); ماء الغسل وما يغسل به أو فيه (`quranic:root_001087:B002/m01`); ذوق الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`); إطعام الغير وطلب الطعام (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); تناول المطعوم (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`); خرقة تحبس صب الماء (`quranic:root_001102:B008/m01`); موضع الاغتسال وآلة التسخين (`quranic:root_000001:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Washing removes grime by flowing water and uses a washing medium or place; taste, feeding, eating, spout-filter, and bath vessel then redirect those sanitation materials toward ingestion. The reversal makes the absence of proper food concrete as contamination of the food category itself.

subchannels.name: Consumption, corrosion, and prey
subchannels.scene_or_process: Eating ranges from nourishment to destructive consumption of body, property, and victim.
subchannels.active_motifs: استهلاك المال وأخذه (`quranic:root_000043:B004/m01`); إطعام النار واشتعالها (`quranic:root_000043:B005/m01`); التآكل والفساد والحكة (`quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`); الفريسة والمعدة للأكل (`quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`); الإفساد والنميمة بين الناس (`quranic:root_000043:B009/m01`); الإدعاء على الغير والتمكين منه (`quranic:root_000043:B010/m01`); قلة الجماعة بقدر رأس (`quranic:root_000043:B011/m01`); قوة الشيء وتمام مادته (`quranic:root_000043:B012/m01`); طعم العقل والقيمة (`quranic:root_000934:B008/m01`); القدرة على الشيء (`quranic:root_000934:B011/m01`); الأخذ بالمطعمة عند الخنق (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); السبع الحيوان المفترس (`quranic:root_000669:B002/m01`); الوقيعة والاغتياب كأذى السبع (`quranic:root_000669:B003/m01`); الخطيئة ذنب وإثم (`quranic:root_000420:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Property consumption, devouring fire, bodily corrosion, prepared prey, social sabotage, false accusation, a group small enough for one head, material strength, reason, power, throat-grip, predator, figurative mauling, and deliberate sin expose eating as appropriation. The punitive meal makes the eater resemble the corrupting appetite that defined the offense.

subchannels.name: Lamp oil and controlled illumination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Combustible material is contained and fed to a flame so heat becomes useful light.
subchannels.active_motifs: السليط زيت يضيء (`quranic:root_000732:B005/m01`); إطعام النار واشتعالها (`quranic:root_000043:B005/m01`); تأجج النار وشدة حرها (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`); السواد والفحم والدخان (`quranic:root_000001:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Illuminating sesame oil, fire consuming fuel, intense flame, and black smoke describe controlled combustion and its residue. This small lamp process contrasts with the unbounded blaze that consumes the condemned body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Heat, fuel, hot liquid, bodily discharge, and food converge in a punitive process that reverses cooking, cleansing, and nourishment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:31 and 69:35-37 join the blaze to the absence of a friend and to corrupt food eaten only by sinners.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene behaves like a furnace and bath gone wrong: fire consumes fuel, heat enters the body, washing residue becomes a meal, and an implement made to straighten by flame becomes an instrument of exposure.

parent_channels.name: P2: Faith is tested as trust and provision

subchannels.name: Secure heart, entrusted charge, and assent
subchannels.scene_or_process: The heart settles into confidence, accepts a report, and proves trustworthy with what it receives.
subchannels.active_motifs: سكون القلب في أمن وثقة (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); قول آمين طلبا للاستجابة (`quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`); الرضا خلاف السخط (`quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`); تلقي الكلام أخذا وتلقينا (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Security, trust, entrusted object, assent, and the prayer for response all turn belief into settled receptivity. Acceptance and learned reception show that faith is both relation to a report and reliability in carrying its consequences.

subchannels.name: Worship, greatness, and reverent scale
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper recognizes the object of devotion as weighty, powerful, and worthy of magnification.
subchannels.active_motifs: التعبد والمعبود (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); اسم الله في القسم والنداء (`quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`); الكبر والقوة (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); معظم الشيء (`quranic:root_001029:B002/m01`); الاستعظام والهيبة (`quranic:root_001029:B007/m01`); الحرمة والشرف (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`); تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Worship and the divine name orient the relation; greatness, the major portion, awe, and honored standing give it scale. Believing assent is therefore not flat acknowledgment but recognition that orders perception and conduct around what is greater.

subchannels.name: Prayer, blessing, and answering response
subchannels.scene_or_process: Devotion rises as prayer and blessing and is met by a voiced response seeking acceptance.
subchannels.active_motifs: الصلاة عبادة لازمة (`quranic:root_000880:B001/m01`); الدعاء والبركة والرحمة (`quranic:root_000880:B002/m01`); الصلوات مواضع عبادة (`quranic:root_000880:B008/m01`); قول آمين طلبا للاستجابة (`quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`); ها للجواب والتلبية (`quranic:root_001573:B003/m01`); تهنئة بخير وولاية (`quranic:root_001604:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ص ل ي`: 69:31 (صَلُّ); `ء م ن`: 69:33 (يُؤْمِنُ); `ه ا ء`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ه ن ء`: 69:24 (هَنِيٓـًٔۢا)
subchannels.synthesis: Obligatory prayer, blessing and mercy, houses of worship, saying amen, answering a call, and congratulatory invocation form a prayer-response scene. The `ه ا ء` response motif is branch-attested but has no available surface-root anchor.

subchannels.name: Urging, reciprocal encouragement, and increased desire
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech and inward appetite are activated so that provision moves toward one who lacks it.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحَضّ على الشيء (`quranic:root_000334:B001/m01`); استزادة النفس (`quranic:root_000334:B004/m01`); إطعام الغير وطلب الطعام (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); الهنء عطاء وكفاية (`quranic:root_001604:B002/m01`); العناية الصادقة بالشيء (`quranic:root_001272:B015/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Exhortation can be mutual, and the self can be pressed to seek more on another's behalf. Feeding, adequate gift, and sincere care specify the intended outcome; the failure in the surface scene is a failure to initiate this social motion.

subchannels.name: Poor person, household, and stabilizing food
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food and shelter arrest involuntary motion by giving a vulnerable person a place and means to remain.
subchannels.active_motifs: ذهاب الحركة (`quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`); استيطان المنزل (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); أهل الدار (`quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`); مأنس السكون (`quranic:root_000726:B004/m01`); ذل المسكنة (`quranic:root_000726:B006/m01`); موضع الاستقرار (`quranic:root_000726:B009/m01`); قوت يثبت المقام (`quranic:root_000726:B010/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`); ائتلاف الشمل بعد تفرق (`quranic:root_000819:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Stillness, dwelling, household, familiar comfort, poverty, stable place, sustaining fodder, livelihood, and gathered company make provision a stabilizing system. The poor person is not only hungry but socially and spatially unanchored; food belongs with household continuity.

subchannels.name: Hidden betrayal, rancor, and shameless hostility
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed moral injury remains inside a social relation until it emerges as hostility or refusal of restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: خيانة مستترة (`quranic:root_001102:B004/m01`); ضغن كامن في الصدر (`quranic:root_001102:B005/m01`); قلة الحياء (`quranic:root_000225:B005/m01`); ظنين معاد (`quranic:root_000969:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Secret betrayal, inward rancor, lack of shame, and an enemy under suspicion form an ethical interior opposite to the secure entrusted heart. Social provision fails where hostility is stored rather than responsibility.

subchannels.name: Hidden beings and the unseen religious field
subchannels.scene_or_process: Religious assent situates human conduct within a field that includes concealed nonhuman beings.
subchannels.active_motifs: الجن المستترون (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`); التعبد والمعبود (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden spirits, worship, and believing assent form a compact unseen religious scene. The latent spirit image sharpens the difference between principled faith in a trustworthy report and uncontrolled concealment of the mind.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Belief is not isolated assent; it creates security, worshipful orientation, and active responsibility for another person's food and dwelling.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:33-34 identifies failure to believe in God and failure to urge feeding the poor as the paired causes of punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Faith's lexical image is a calm heart holding a trust, while neglect of the poor is rendered as refusal to set desire, household, land, and food in motion toward them.

parent_channels.name: P2: Negation strips companion, place, and release

subchannels.name: No companion and no ordinary category
subchannels.scene_or_process: Negation removes available persons and things from the condemned person's present field.
subchannels.active_motifs: ليس جحود ينفي الحال كفعل جامد (`quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`); ليس استثناء يخرج المذكور (`quranic:root_001390:B002/m01`); ليس تقوم مقام لا في النسق والتبرئة (`quranic:root_001390:B003/m01`); الحميم والحامة في القربى (`quranic:root_000001:B011/m01`); إخراج المستثنى من الحكم (`quranic:root_000436:B004/m01`); خلاك ذم (`quranic:root_000436:B005/m01`); البراءة والخروج من التبعة (`quranic:root_000436:B006/m01`); ها للتنبيه والافتتاح (`quranic:root_001573:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ل ي س`: 69:35 (لَيْسَ); `ح م م`: 69:35 (حَمِيمٌ); `خ ل و`: 69:24 (خَالِيَةِ); `ه ا ء`: unavailable (surface root missing)
subchannels.synthesis: Grammatical denial, exception, and categorical exclusion close the inventory. The close kinsman is absent; blame, liability, and affiliation are removed through formulas of exclusion and disavowal. The deictic 'here' is branch-attested under `ه ا ء` but lacks a surface-root anchor.

subchannels.name: Empty dwelling and elapsed inhabitants
subchannels.scene_or_process: A place remains after its occupants, generation, or expected guardian has gone.
subchannels.active_motifs: تعري الشيء وخلو المكان (`quranic:root_000436:B001/m01`); الانفراد والخلوة (`quranic:root_000436:B002/m01`); مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن (`quranic:root_000436:B003/m01`); خلو القلب من الهم (`quranic:root_000436:B007/m01`); الخلاة لمن لا حافظ له (`quranic:root_000436:B016/m01`); الغنى بالمكان (`quranic:root_001110:B004/m01`); استيطان المنزل (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); أهل الدار (`quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Vacant place, private isolation, elapsed generation, heart without concern, unguarded person, former dwelling, house, and household define absence through habitation. The condemned 'here' is a place whose normal social occupants and protections have been removed.

subchannels.name: Release, divorce, and abandoned relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bond is opened so each party or dependent is left to a separate course.
subchannels.active_motifs: التخلية والإرسال (`quranic:root_000436:B008/m01`); الخلو من الزوج أو الولد (`quranic:root_000436:B009/m01`); الخلية من الإبل (`quranic:root_000436:B010/m01`); المخالاة في المفارقة والمصارعة (`quranic:root_000436:B014/m01`); السخرية أو المخادعة في الخلو (`quranic:root_000436:B015/m01`); ائتلاف الشمل بعد تفرق (`quranic:root_000819:B002/m01`); المراضاة والتراضي رضا متبادل (`quranic:root_000569:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Release, divorced or childless status, a dam separated from her young, broken truce, mutual exposure in wrestling, deception in private, scattered company, and lost mutual satisfaction describe relational unbinding. Freedom and abandonment share the same opening operation but differ in who benefits.

subchannels.name: Stationary courage, weakness, and tolerated burden
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person remains in place either from steadfast courage, heavy inertia, patient tolerance, or failed judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: الأليس شجاع لا تروعه الحرب (`quranic:root_001390:B004/m01`); الأليس ملازم لا يبرح مكانه (`quranic:root_001390:B005/m01`); تلايس احتمال وتغاض حسن الخلق (`quranic:root_001390:B006/m01`); الأليس ضعيف الرأي (`quranic:root_001390:B007/m01`); الأليس ذم لمن لا يغار (`quranic:root_001390:B008/m01`); ضعف وقلة حيلة (`quranic:root_000969:B008/m01`); ذهاب الحركة (`quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fearless fighter, immovable homebody, tolerant bearer, weak counselor, dishonored complacency, little capacity, and stillness all produce non-movement. The scene distinguishes principled staying from inability or moral indifference by the cause of the same visible posture.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The condemned state is formed by successive absences: no effective wealth, no authority, no close companion, no ordinary food, and no open path away.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:28-36 repeatedly negates benefit, authority, companion, and food.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lexical absence expands into empty house, elapsed generation, divorce, unguarded object, stationary homebody, and grammatical exclusion.

parent_channels.name: P2: Hidden life proceeds toward birth

subchannels.name: Womb, concealed fetus, and gathered bodily matter
subchannels.scene_or_process: An interior chamber gathers blood or seed and shelters developing life.
subchannels.active_motifs: الجنين المستور في البطن (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); الجنان المستور في الصدر (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`); الجناجن عظام الصدر (`quranic:root_000266:B016/m01`); قرء الحيض والطهر (`quranic:root_001210:B003/m01`); رحم يجمع حملا (`quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`); وقت الشيء ودورانه (`quranic:root_001211:B002/m01`); اجتماع الرحم وحمله (`quranic:root_001211:B003/m01`); لقاح جزئي أو حمل الناقة (`quranic:root_000819:B012/m01`); دخول ثابت في الخلال (`quranic:root_001102:B001/m01`); إمساك للاستبراء أو حبس (`quranic:root_001210:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fetus, inward heart-chamber, chest bones, menstrual or pure interval, womb-gathered pregnancy, partial conception, penetration, and detention for pregnancy verification form a concealed reproductive assembly. The body is both container and timed process.

subchannels.name: Readiness, mating, and uncertain fertility
subchannels.scene_or_process: Female readiness and male performance are tested by whether conception actually follows.
subchannels.active_motifs: استئتاء الناقة (`quranic:root_000009:B012/m01`); قرء الناقة في الضبعة والوداق (`quranic:root_001210:B009/m01`); سرعة اللقاح (`quranic:root_001372:B003/m01`); فحل يكثر الضراب ولا يلقح (`quranic:root_001087:B003/m01`); لقاح جزئي أو حمل الناقة (`quranic:root_000819:B012/m01`); امرأة يرجى ولدها (`quranic:root_000969:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mare in heat, camel mating-readiness, rapid conception, a frequently mating but infertile male, partial insemination, and a woman from whom children are hoped describe the uncertain transition from coupling to generation.

subchannels.name: Approaching birth, first growth, and ripened issue
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hidden process becomes externally legible as its time and product approach.
subchannels.active_motifs: قرب النتاج (`quranic:root_000493:B004/m01`); جن الشيء في بدايته (`quranic:root_000266:B014/m01`); دنو القِطاف وحلول وقته (`quranic:root_001241:B003/m01`); إدراك الثمر وأخذ الطعم (`quranic:root_000934:B005/m01`); إطعام الغصن وقبول الوصل (`quranic:root_000934:B010/m01`); خروج النماء والنتاج (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); هناءة الماشية من النبت (`quranic:root_001604:B003/m01`); تتابع الخلق (`quranic:root_000934:B014/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Near delivery, the first stage of youth, harvest time, fruit taking flavor, successful graft, emerging produce, an animal's share of fresh growth, and successive formation all express maturation becoming available at the boundary.

subchannels.name: Offspring, age, and family naming
subchannels.scene_or_process: New life is classified by species, age, and social name.
subchannels.active_motifs: سلفان الحجل (`quranic:root_000733:B011/m01`); المرأة المسلف (`quranic:root_000733:B012/m01`); رضوى ورضيا أسماء (`quranic:root_000570:B003/m01`); رضوى ورضيا أعلام من المادة (`quranic:root_000569:B007/m01`); ولد الحجل والقطا (`quranic:root_000735:B006/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `س ل ف`: 69:24 (أَسْلَفْ); `ر ض ي`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ر ض و`: 69:21 (رَّاضِيَةٍ); `س ل ك`: 69:32 (ٱسْلُكُ)
subchannels.synthesis: Partridge chicks, mature woman, personal and mountain names, and young sandgrouse classify generation after emergence by species, age, and social identity. The `ر ض ي` name motif lacks a surface-root anchor; its role here is lexical naming, not a claimed surface occurrence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Generation moves through concealed interior, sexual readiness, conception, gestation, visible swelling, and the appointed time of emergence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the garden's hidden growth and the rewarded 'life' in 69:21-24 activate a dense reproductive process without narrating a birth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The process connects womb, menstrual interval, animal heat, hoped-for child, near delivery, fruit ripening, grafting, and failed fertility.

parent_channels.name: P2: Speech moves between utterance, belief, and verdict

subchannels.name: Voiced statement and circulating talk
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker externalizes words that pass among people as report or negotiation.
subchannels.active_motifs: إخراج القول بالنطق (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); اللسان آلة القول (`quranic:root_001272:B002/m01`); كثرة القول في صاحبه (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); القول الفاشي بين الناس (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); المقاولة في الأمر (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); قراءة وتلاوة وإقراء (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); الغِناء والصوت (`quranic:root_001110:B003/m01`); إفراط اللسان والكلام (`quranic:root_000512:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Utterance, tongue, fluent speaker, circulating report, mutual discussion, recitation, song, and excessive speech form the audible social life of the statement. Reading the record is therefore one regulated form within a wider field of speech circulation.

subchannels.name: Fabricated attribution, inward statement, and proposition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech may be falsely assigned, silently held, adopted as belief, or abstracted into a definition.
subchannels.active_motifs: قول ما لم يكن أو نسبته (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); اجترار القول إلى النفس (`quranic:root_001272:B006/m01`); قول يجري مجرى الظن (`quranic:root_001272:B011/m01`); قول في النفس لم يظهر (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); القول اعتقاد ومذهب (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`); قول الشيء دلالته (`quranic:root_001272:B014/m01`); قول الشيء حده (`quranic:root_001272:B016/m01`); شك وتوهم (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); تهمة وظنة (`quranic:root_000969:B004/m01`); سوء الظن بالناس (`quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Putting words in another's mouth, appropriating a saying, using speech as conjecture, keeping it inward, holding a doctrine, letting a thing 'say' by sign, and defining its essence move speech away from simple sound. Doubt, accusation, and habitual suspicion expose the ethical risk in that expansion.

subchannels.name: Knowledge, search, and reception of instruction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A knower seeks, discovers, and takes in information by inquiry or directed approach.
subchannels.active_motifs: الدراية والعلم (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); قصد الشيء واعتماده (`quranic:root_000473:B002/m01`); الختل والاستتار للصيد (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); المدرى والحد المحدد (`quranic:root_000473:B004/m01`); الحسبان والظن (`quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`); التحسب والاستخبار (`quranic:root_000318:B010/m01`); تلقي الكلام أخذا وتلقينا (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`); قارئ ناسك متفقه (`quranic:root_001210:B006/m01`); الشرب فهما (`quranic:root_000783:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Knowledge, targeted search, hidden approach, pointed tool, estimation, inquiry, verbal reception, learned devotional reading, and 'drinking' as understanding form an epistemic acquisition scene. Search can be intellectual or physically staged like a hunt, but both require directed attention and uptake.

subchannels.name: Ruling speech and the force of proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim becomes operative when backed by proof, office, and a conclusive decision.
subchannels.active_motifs: السلطان حجة قاهرة (`quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`); السلطان قدرة وولاية (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); لسان سليط حاد صخاب (`quranic:root_000732:B004/m01`); الحكم والأمر القاطع (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); الإبلاغ والوصية القاطعة (`quranic:root_001237:B002/m01`); القيل صاحب القول النافذ (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m01`); اقتالة الحكم على غيره (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); إثبات يوجب حكما أو قدرا (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Prevailing proof, delegated authority, sharp tongue, adjudication, formal notice, authoritative speaker, imposed judgment, and written decree join discourse to enforcement. The verdict is speech whose social conditions make it binding.

subchannels.name: Particle, interrogative substitute, and letter-name
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small grammatical forms orient clauses, questions, negations, and written sound.
subchannels.active_motifs: حرف عَلَى وما جرى مجراه (`quranic:root_001042:B012/m01`); ها بدل ألف الاستفهام (`quranic:root_001573:B004/m01`); الهاء حرف هجاء (`quranic:root_001573:B006/m01`); ليس جحود ينفي الحال كفعل جامد (`quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ع ل و`: 69:22 (عَالِيَةٍ); `ه ا ء`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ل ي س`: 69:35 (لَيْسَ)
subchannels.synthesis: The preposition `ala`, a deictic form replacing an interrogative alif, the name of the letter ha, and grammatical negation form a compact language-mechanics scene. The `ه ا ء` forms have no available surface-root anchor.

subchannels.name: Claim of unconsumed drink and contested conduct
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker imputes an act to another, who must distinguish actual conduct from verbal accusation.
subchannels.active_motifs: دعوى ما لم يشرب (`quranic:root_000783:B010/m01`); قول ما لم يكن أو نسبته (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); تهمة وظنة (`quranic:root_000969:B004/m01`); التحسب والاستخبار (`quranic:root_000318:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The claim that another drank what they did not, fabricated attribution, accusation, and inquiry into the report create a compact dispute over conduct and evidence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A statement can be voiced, circulated, negotiated, held inwardly, treated as a proposition, or imposed as judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:19, 69:25, and 69:26 stage first-person utterance, public address, and retrospective knowledge.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech becomes tongue, reputation, bargaining, private thought, logical definition, song, excessive talk, and a sharp instrument of authority.

parent_channels.name: P2: Cloth is wrapped, lined, threaded, and worn

subchannels.name: Wrapping, underlayer, and hidden load
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth encloses the body and creates an inner layer in which another object may be concealed.
subchannels.active_motifs: لف الثوب واشتماله (`quranic:root_000819:B003/m01`); حمل مستور في الاشتمال (`quranic:root_000819:B005/m01`); غلالة بين الثياب (`quranic:root_001102:B007/m01`); السلفة بطانة الخف (`quranic:root_000733:B013/m01`); القطيفة ذات الخمل وما يشبهها (`quranic:root_001241:B007/m01`); الستر والاستتار (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); الجُنّة الواقية (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); مواراة الميت (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cloak, object hidden under the cloak, undergarment, shoe lining, plush cover, generic concealment, shield, and burial covering organize textile by layers. Protection and concealment are neighboring but distinct uses of the same enclosing surface.

subchannels.name: Thread, joined leather, and extended edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Thread passes through joined material and continues as a stable seam or border.
subchannels.active_motifs: إدخال الشيء في الشيء (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); الخيط الذي يخاط به (`quranic:root_000735:B004/m01`); طرة ممتدة في ناحية الثوب (`quranic:root_000735:B005/m01`); ضم شيء إلى شيء (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); دخول ثابت في الخلال (`quranic:root_001102:B001/m01`); بلى السقاء لطول الترك (`quranic:root_001237:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Insertion, sewing thread, long selvedge, joined leather, penetration between parts, and decayed waterskin form a complete seam-making scene. A worn container fails where the join no longer holds.

subchannels.name: Cut cloth, polished pattern, and misleading color
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface is cut and finished into a visible textile whose appearance may or may not disclose its substance.
subchannels.active_motifs: لف الثوب واشتماله (`quranic:root_000819:B003/m01`); القطيفة ذات الخمل وما يشبهها (`quranic:root_001241:B007/m01`); بقية لحم في الإهاب (`quranic:root_001102:B012/m01`); لون الأحسب والأحسبية (`quranic:root_000318:B009/m01`); عود القال لضرب القلة (`quranic:root_001272:B008/m01`); طرة ممتدة في ناحية الثوب (`quranic:root_000735:B005/m01`); مخالطة اللون والقلب (`quranic:root_000783:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Wrapped cloth, pile fabric, flesh left on a hide, mottled coloring, color absorbed into material or heart, a wooden bat, and an extended textile edge place finish and appearance beside imperfect preparation. The scene pressures the book's legibility by asking whether a surface is well made or merely visually persuasive.

subchannels.name: Protective covering and bodily stilling
subchannels.scene_or_process: A made covering shields a vulnerable body or arrests its movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: الجُنّة الواقية (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); مواراة الميت (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`); إسكان الذبيحة بالسكين (`quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`); شد وعاء يشتمل على الحيوان أو النخلة (`quranic:root_000819:B004/m01`); طوق يغل العضو (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); غلالة بين الثياب (`quranic:root_001102:B007/m01`); الأخذ بالذراع وتذريعه (`quranic:root_000512:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Shield, burial cover, knife, tied udder cover, iron collar, under-armor layer, and arm-restraint all use material at the body boundary. Protection and punishment diverge according to whether the covering intercepts harm or fixes the person inside it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Textile construction proceeds from joined material through inner lining, thread-path, cut edge, wrapping, and protective or deceptive surface.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the book's joined leaves and the chain's serial construction activate craft operations adjacent to the surface judgment scene.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Garment making reaches waterskin stitching, shoe lining, plush bedding, hidden sword, under-armor layer, leather residue, and cloth whose colors misrepresent its state.

parent_channels.name: P2: Water is routed from channel to throat

subchannels.name: Runoff, channel, and incoming yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water arrives from elsewhere, is directed through a course, and produces growth at its destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: مجرى الماء وتسليك سبيله (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); السيل الآتي من غير البلد (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); خروج النماء والنتاج (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); ماء وموضع ونبت في الشجر (`quranic:root_001102:B003/m01`); أرض ونبت ريان (`quranic:root_000783:B014/m01`); البستان المستور بالشجر (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); التفاف النبات واندفاعه (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); السلوف في أوائل الإبل (`quranic:root_000733:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Channel, imported runoff, increased water or yield, hidden stream among trees, moist ground, garden, dense vegetation, and lead animal at the watering place form a routed irrigation scene. Arrival becomes productive because the flow is guided rather than merely abundant.

subchannels.name: Drink, share, vessel, and bodily passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Liquid is allotted, contained, taken through mouth and throat, and judged by its ease or bitterness.
subchannels.active_motifs: تناول المائع (`quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`); نصيب الماء (`quranic:root_000783:B002/m01`); جماعة الشرب والمشارب (`quranic:root_000783:B003/m01`); موضع الشرب وآلته (`quranic:root_000783:B004/m01`); ماء يشرب مع كراهة (`quranic:root_000783:B005/m01`); شارب الفم ومجاري الحلق (`quranic:root_000783:B006/m01`); مد العنق للنظر (`quranic:root_000783:B009/m01`); السلاسة في الجري والشرب (`quranic:root_000731:B001/m01`); وعاء الأكل وموضعه (`quranic:root_000043:B013/m01`); هناءة بلا مشقة ولا وخامة (`quranic:root_001604:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Drink, water-share, drinking cohort, room or cup, saline liquid, lip and throat channels, raised neck, smooth flow, bowl, and easy digestion trace liquid from social allocation into the body. Taste and posture reveal whether the passage is welcome or forced.

subchannels.name: Seasoned skin, filter, and washing place
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel is sealed and filtered, then used to pour or wash.
subchannels.active_motifs: تطييب القربة وتشريبها (`quranic:root_000783:B013/m01`); خرقة تحبس صب الماء (`quranic:root_001102:B008/m01`); تطهير الشيء بإسالة الماء وإزالة الدرن (`quranic:root_001087:B001/m01`); ماء الغسل وما يغسل به أو فيه (`quranic:root_001087:B002/m01`); الماء الحار والاغتسال به (`quranic:root_000001:B002/m01`); موضع الاغتسال وآلة التسخين (`quranic:root_000001:B013/m01`); بلى السقاء لطول الترك (`quranic:root_001237:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Seasoning closes a waterskin's stitches; a cloth filter controls its spout; flowing cleanser, washing medium, hot water, bath vessel, and an old skin that has decayed complete the container's life cycle from preparation to failure.

subchannels.name: Vessel, hive, and stabilizing rudder
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hollow structure carries or stores fluid products and is kept from uncontrolled motion.
subchannels.active_motifs: الخلية السفينة (`quranic:root_000436:B011/m01`); خلية النحل (`quranic:root_000436:B012/m01`); تسكين السفينة بالسكان (`quranic:root_000726:B008/m01`); مجرى الماء وتسليك سبيله (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); امتداد ملتف متعاقب (`quranic:root_000731:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Large vessel, bee-hive, ship's steering or balancing member, water channel, and chain-like lightning or sand all use guided extension around a hollow or moving body. The rudder supplies the key operation: stability within a fluid environment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water moves through runoff, channel, basin, vessel, throat, body, washing, and irrigated ground.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:24's command to drink and 69:35-36's punitive food create the intake contrast around which the hydrological imagery gathers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes foreign floodwater, a ruddered vessel, honeycomb, smooth drink, saline water, seasoned skin, hidden valley stream, bath, and lush pasture.

parent_channels.name: P2: Punishment is mapped onto limbs and inner organs

subchannels.name: Hand, forearm, neck, and choke
subchannels.scene_or_process: External force controls the body through its grasping and load-bearing joints.
subchannels.active_motifs: الذراع جارحة ممدودة (`quranic:root_000512:B001/m01`); القياس بالذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B002/m01`); الذرع طاقة ومدى (`quranic:root_000512:B004/m01`); الأخذ بالذراع وتذريعه (`quranic:root_000512:B007/m01`); على حبل الذراع حاضر (`quranic:root_000512:B009/m01`); خفيف اليد في العمل (`quranic:root_000512:B010/m01`); طوق يغل العضو (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); الأخذ بالمطعمة عند الخنق (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); إدخال الحبل في العنق (`quranic:root_000783:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Arm, cubit, capacity, arm-grip, immediate arm's reach, skilled hand, iron collar, throat-seizure, and neck-rope map restraint through connected limbs. Measurement and control meet at the forearm, which is both bodily lever and standard of length.

subchannels.name: Mouth, throat, speech, and forced passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: The same passage carries drink, food, voice, and constricting pressure.
subchannels.active_motifs: شارب الفم ومجاري الحلق (`quranic:root_000783:B006/m01`); مد العنق للنظر (`quranic:root_000783:B009/m01`); الشرب فهما (`quranic:root_000783:B011/m01`); ذوق الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`); طعم العقل والقيمة (`quranic:root_000934:B008/m01`); الأخذ بالمطعمة عند الخنق (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); التطاعم بالفم (`quranic:root_000934:B013/m01`); إفراط اللسان والكلام (`quranic:root_000512:B011/m01`); لسان سليط حاد صخاب (`quranic:root_000732:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Lip, throat channels, raised neck, understanding, taste, reason, throat-grip, mouth-to-mouth contact, excessive talk, and sharp tongue turn the oral passage into a contested interface. What normally communicates and nourishes can be constricted or compelled.

subchannels.name: Back, bone, eye, and altered bodily profile
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hard support and visible contour register strain, disease, or artificial modification.
subchannels.active_motifs: الصَّلا موضع الظهر والذنب (`quranic:root_000880:B006/m01`); المصلي يتلو السابق (`quranic:root_000880:B007/m01`); مستغلظ العضو (`quranic:root_001029:B003/m01`); العَظْم الصلب (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); عظامة الردف (`quranic:root_001029:B008/m01`); خشبة الرحل (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); العين المتوقدة أو الجاحظة (`quranic:root_000225:B003/m01`); المحسبة والوسادة (`quranic:root_000318:B008/m01`); لون الأحسب والأحسبية (`quranic:root_000318:B009/m01`); دنو الأعلى من الوسط (`quranic:root_000493:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Lower back, runner behind the leader, thick limb, bone, padded rump, saddle wood, inflamed or staring eye, cushion, mottled skin, and stooped upper body produce a body read through support and profile. Punishment deforms the same structural system that normally carries and seats.

subchannels.name: Heat, vomiting, colic, and failed interior control
subchannels.scene_or_process: Internal pressure overcomes the body's ability to contain fluid, food, or breath.
subchannels.active_motifs: العرق وأثر الحر (`quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`); الحمى والحمام في الأبدان والأرض (`quranic:root_000001:B005/m01`); سبق الشيء وغلبته (`quranic:root_000512:B006/m01`); حرارة تنغل في الجوف (`quranic:root_001102:B002/m01`); تلهب الوجه بالغضب (`quranic:root_000225:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Sweat, fever, involuntary vomiting, inward burning thirst, and a face flaring with anger describe heat and pressure breaching inner regulation.

subchannels.name: Face, neck, foreskin, and surface wound
subchannels.scene_or_process: Named bodily surfaces are exposed to distortion, cutting, or abrasion.
subchannels.active_motifs: عوج يأخذ الوجه (`quranic:root_001372:B001/m01`); السالفة من العنق (`quranic:root_000733:B007/m01`); السلف القلفة (`quranic:root_000733:B009/m01`); خدش الوجه ونحوه (`quranic:root_001241:B006/m01`); أسماء بعلامة الذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Facial palsy, front or side of the neck, foreskin, facial scratch, and names derived from an arm-mark map bodily identity through exposed surfaces and their alteration.

subchannels.name: Epidemic, madness, and bitter medicine
subchannels.scene_or_process: Disease can spread through a place, cover the mind, and call for an aversive treatment.
subchannels.active_motifs: قرأة البلاد ووبؤها (`quranic:root_001210:B008/m01`); ستر العقل بالجنون (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`); الحُضُض دواء مر (`quranic:root_000334:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Regional epidemic, mind covered by madness, and bitter medicinal resin form a compact diagnostic-treatment scene spanning place, cognition, and remedy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Control and suffering are localized at hand, arm, neck, throat, back, eye, belly, bone, and breath.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:30-32 physically takes, fetters, burns, measures, and inserts the condemned body.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The anatomy reaches speech organs, a padded seat, hip enlargement, eye inflammation, vomiting, colic, and the amount a forearm can physically span.

parent_channels.name: P2: Arrival resolves into encounter, route, or stoppage

subchannels.name: Coming, road, and foreign entrant
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mover enters by a known way, sometimes as outsider, payment, produce, or calamity.
subchannels.active_motifs: الإتيان والمجيء (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); الغريب الداخل في غير قومه (`quranic:root_000009:B006/m01`); الإتاوة المؤداة (`quranic:root_000009:B008/m01`); رجع يدي الناقة في السير (`quranic:root_000009:B009/m01`); الميتاء طريق ومحاذاة (`quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`); إتيان البلاء والهلاك (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`); نَفاذ الرجل (`quranic:root_000009:B013/m01`); النفاذ في الطريق (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`); الطعنة المستقيمة تلقاء الوجه (`quranic:root_000735:B003/m01`); مشي الدابة المتقارب البطيء (`quranic:root_001241:B005/m01`); القصد والطلب نحو الشيء (`quranic:root_000001:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival, outsider, tribute, camel foreleg return, public road, disaster that overtakes, penetrating man, road passage, straight thrust, close slow gait, and directed intent distinguish kinds of coming by agent, path, and force.

subchannels.name: Meeting, throwing, and joining endpoints
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two trajectories meet, or an object is cast so that it comes to lie before another.
subchannels.active_motifs: توافي شيئين متقابلين (`quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`); طرح الشيء حتى يلقى (`quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`); شيء مطروح متروك (`quranic:root_001372:B006/m01`); ما يلقاه المرء من خير أو شر (`quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`); انبطاح على القفا (`quranic:root_001372:B009/m01`); جعل طرفين يلتقيان (`quranic:root_001372:B010/m01`); الإيتاء والإعطاء (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); حوز الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Encounter, casting, discarded object, received good or harm, lying on the back, and bringing two ends together form the terminal geometry of motion. Giving and taking specify the social relation at that meeting point.

subchannels.name: Capacity, break in travel, and permanent station
subchannels.scene_or_process: Movement stops because a body reaches its limit, a route fails, or residence becomes fixed.
subchannels.active_motifs: امتداد الخطو والسعي (`quranic:root_000512:B003/m01`); الذرع طاقة ومدى (`quranic:root_000512:B004/m01`); أمر لا يوثق بعاقبته (`quranic:root_000969:B006/m01`); ضعف وقلة حيلة (`quranic:root_000969:B008/m01`); الغنى بالمكان (`quranic:root_001110:B004/m01`); ذهاب الحركة (`quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`); استيطان المنزل (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); موضع الاستقرار (`quranic:root_000726:B009/m01`); استهلاك الجهد واستفراغه (`quranic:root_001596:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Long stride and bodily capacity confront uncertain outcome, weakness, settled dwelling, stillness, house, stable station, and self-consuming effort. Stoppage can be chosen habitation or the forced end of an exhausted journey.

subchannels.name: Borderland, byway, and directional side
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travel is located by the edge between settled and open land and by the side from which movement proceeds.
subchannels.active_motifs: النواحي ومشارف العمران (`quranic:root_000512:B008/m01`); أعلام وأجزاء تسمى بالذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B013/m01`); جهة الشمال خلاف اليمين (`quranic:root_000819:B006/m01`); ريح الشمال وما تبرده (`quranic:root_000819:B007/m01`); الميتاء طريق ومحاذاة (`quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`); النفاذ في الطريق (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Outskirts near houses and palms, named arm-like landmarks, leftward side, north wind, public route, and traversable path create an oriented border landscape. The body supplies measures and directional terms for geography.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement has three decisive moments: the way by which something comes, the meeting at its end, and the condition that permits or prevents further passage.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:19-32 moves records and persons through giving, meeting, seizure, fire, and insertion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The route expands into a public road, camel foreleg motion, straight thrust, cast-off object, slow gait, illness that breaks travel, and residence that outlasts movement.

parent_channels.name: P2: Time advances from prior act to final due point

subchannels.name: Precedence, elapsed days, and stored consequence
subchannels.scene_or_process: What occurs earlier remains causally available when the later outcome arrives.
subchannels.active_motifs: التقدم والسبق (`quranic:root_000733:B001/m01`); السلفة قبل الطعام (`quranic:root_000733:B003/m01`); المال المقدم (`quranic:root_000733:B005/m01`); مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن (`quranic:root_000436:B003/m01`); وقت النهار المحدود (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); مدة من الزمان (`quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`); كائنة اليوم وشدته (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); الإتيان والمجيء (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); إتيان البلاء والهلاك (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Prior action, advance meal, prepaid capital, elapsed generations, ordinary day, extended duration, severe day, arrival, and overtaking calamity organize before and after. The later scene is the arrival of what the earlier act placed in motion.

subchannels.name: Bodily and agricultural intervals
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recurring biological and seasonal times regulate readiness, maturation, and harvest.
subchannels.active_motifs: قرء الحيض والطهر (`quranic:root_001210:B003/m01`); وقت يحين أو يتأخر (`quranic:root_001210:B005/m01`); قرء الناقة في الضبعة والوداق (`quranic:root_001210:B009/m01`); وقت الشيء ودورانه (`quranic:root_001211:B002/m01`); دنو القِطاف وحلول وقته (`quranic:root_001241:B003/m01`); قرب النتاج (`quranic:root_000493:B004/m01`); استئتاء الناقة (`quranic:root_000009:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Menstrual or pure interval, wind-time, mating readiness, harvest time, near birth, and animal heat make time legible through changing bodies and crops. These are clocks whose units are states rather than numerals.

subchannels.name: Due moment, completion, and death
subchannels.scene_or_process: A process reaches the point at which its result is fixed and no further extension remains.
subchannels.active_motifs: دنو الأمر وحضوره (`quranic:root_000001:B006/m01`); القضاء والقدر والموت (`quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`); المنية والقضاء النافذ بالموت (`quranic:root_001237:B003/m01`); الفراغ والتمام والانقضاء (`quranic:root_001237:B004/m01`); إحكام الصنع وإنفاذ الفعل (`quranic:root_001237:B005/m01`); أمر لا يوثق بعاقبته (`quranic:root_000969:B006/m01`); الشمال موضع شؤم أو خساسة (`quranic:root_000819:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Due arrival, decreed death, mortality, completion, executed making, uncertain outcome, and failed lot converge on finalization. The wish for the decisive ending is a wish that the temporal process had terminated before its consequences unfolded.

subchannels.name: Aging, first stage, and deteriorated material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Time appears in bodies and artifacts as youth, maturity, age, and decay.
subchannels.active_motifs: جن الشيء في بدايته (`quranic:root_000266:B014/m01`); المرأة المسلف (`quranic:root_000733:B012/m01`); الشيخ المنسوب إلى كُنْتُ (`quranic:root_001332:B005/m01`); بلى السقاء لطول الترك (`quranic:root_001237:B007/m01`); الحمى والحمام في الأبدان والأرض (`quranic:root_000001:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Beginning of youth, mature woman, elder who speaks in the past tense, decayed waterskin, and fevered body show time as alteration of capacity and material integrity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Earlier deed, recurring interval, ripening, due time, and termination form a causal chronology.
