parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:24 explicitly connects present ease to what was sent ahead in past days, while 69:27 longs for a final ending.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal order is materialized as menstruation, animal heat, harvest, advance meal, debt maturity, fever's due moment, and waterskin decay.

parent_channels.name: P2: Social rank is built from household, approval, and reputation

subchannels.name: Household, spouse, and familiar rest
subchannels.scene_or_process: A stable domestic unit joins residence, spouse, dependents, and emotional repose.
subchannels.active_motifs: استيطان المنزل (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); أهل الدار (`quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`); مأنس السكون (`quranic:root_000726:B004/m01`); الانفراد والخلوة (`quranic:root_000436:B002/m01`); الخلو من الزوج أو الولد (`quranic:root_000436:B009/m01`); الغانية المستغنية (`quranic:root_001110:B005/m01`); الغنى والتزويج (`quranic:root_001110:B006/m01`); سلف المصاهرة (`quranic:root_000733:B006/m01`); ائتلاف الشمل بعد تفرق (`quranic:root_000819:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: House, household, familiar comfort, privacy, divorced status, self-sufficient wife, marriage as protection, intermarried relatives, and reunited family define domestic stability by the relations that can also be lost.

subchannels.name: Approval, obedience, guarantee, and named identity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is socially received through consent, trusted service, guarantee, and public naming.
subchannels.active_motifs: الرضا خلاف السخط (`quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`); الرضوان والمرضاة اسم للرضا الكثير أو المطلوب (`quranic:root_000569:B002/m01`); المراضاة والتراضي رضا متبادل (`quranic:root_000569:B003/m01`); الإرضاء طلب رضا الغير وإزالة سخطه (`quranic:root_000569:B004/m01`); راضاني فرضوته غلبة في ذلك (`quranic:root_000569:B005/m01`); الرضي صفة للمطيع أو المحب أو الضامن (`quranic:root_000569:B006/m01`); رضوى ورضيا أعلام من المادة (`quranic:root_000569:B007/m01`); الرِّضا خلاف السخط والقبول (`quranic:root_000570:B001/m01`); غلبة راضاني فرضوته (`quranic:root_000570:B002/m01`); رضوى ورضيا أسماء (`quranic:root_000570:B003/m01`); الرَّضِيّ طاعة ومحبة وضمان (`quranic:root_000570:B004/m01`); تهنئة بخير وولاية (`quranic:root_001604:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ر ض و`: 69:21 (رَّاضِيَةٍ); `ر ض ي`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ه ن ء`: 69:24 (هَنِيٓـًٔۢا)
subchannels.synthesis: Acceptance, abundant favor, mutual consent, active pleasing, competitive approval, obedient or guaranteeing associate, and personal names organize social reception. Congratulation publicly ratifies the good state. All `ر ض ي` motifs are lexically attested but surface-root anchors are unavailable.

subchannels.name: Reputation, song, fluent speech, and inherited honor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Public standing is produced and circulated through voice, ancestry, and visible accomplishment.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحسب والمآثر (`quranic:root_000318:B004/m01`); الغِناء والصوت (`quranic:root_001110:B003/m01`); لسان سليط حاد صخاب (`quranic:root_000732:B004/m01`); كثرة القول في صاحبه (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); القول الفاشي بين الناس (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); الحرمة والشرف (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ancestral honor, song, forceful tongue, verbal fluency, circulating report, and social dignity make reputation an acoustic and genealogical asset. Its loss parallels the disappearance of wealth and authority.

subchannels.name: Crowd, dependent property, and provision-bearing group
subchannels.scene_or_process: People, dependents, and livestock gather as a resource-bearing social body.
subchannels.active_motifs: سواد الناس وجماعتهم (`quranic:root_000266:B013/m01`); القِرَة مال وعيال (`quranic:root_001210:B013/m01`); الحميم والحامة في القربى (`quranic:root_000001:B011/m01`); كرائم المال والإبل (`quranic:root_000001:B014/m01`); أهل الدار (`quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`); قوت يثبت المقام (`quranic:root_000726:B010/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mass of people, property and dependents, close kin, choice stock, household, sustaining pasture, and livelihood describe a group whose bonds are simultaneously emotional and economic.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Standing in a community depends on household attachment, recognized character, mutual approval, public reputation, and the ability to provide.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:21-24 portrays accepted well-being, while 69:28-35 removes wealth, authority, companion, and provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field includes householder, poor resident, divorced woman, in-law, guarantor, singer, sharp speaker, honor inherited from ancestors, and a mountain used as a personal name.

parent_channels.name: P2: Life is experienced as condition and station

subchannels.name: Life, livelihood, and satisfying condition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living state is maintained by the means and quality of daily existence.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحياة والعيشة (`quranic:root_001067:B001/m01`); المعيشة والمعاش (`quranic:root_001067:B002/m01`); الرضا خلاف السخط (`quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`); مال يؤكل ويشرب (`quranic:root_000783:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Life, livelihood, accepted condition, provision, and wealth expended on food and drink define flourishing through sustained means. Satisfaction describes the quality of a materially supported life.

subchannels.name: Being, place, rank, and bad state
subchannels.scene_or_process: Existence appears as occurring in time, occupying a place, holding a station, or enduring a degraded condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: وقوع الشيء وحضوره في زمان (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); المكان والمكانة من الكون (`quranic:root_001332:B002/m01`); حالة السوء بكينة (`quranic:root_001332:B006/m01`); الغنى بالمكان (`quranic:root_001110:B004/m01`); مظنة الشيء وموضعه (`quranic:root_000969:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Occurrence, place and rank, bad condition, long residence, and the expected location of a thing turn being into situated presence. Condition can therefore be read from where and how one remains.

subchannels.name: Standing for another and submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: One person becomes answerable for another, or lowers themselves beneath an authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: الكفالة والقيام على فلان (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); الخضوع بالاستكانة (`quranic:root_001332:B004/m01`); الرضي صفة للمطيع أو المحب أو الضامن (`quranic:root_000569:B006/m01`); ذل المسكنة (`quranic:root_000726:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Guarantee, submission, obedient or guaranteeing associate, and humbled poverty describe dependence through altered standing. The same social posture may be responsible care or coerced abasement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Living is not bare existence but a condition sustained by food, drink, place, household, and the capacity to stand for another.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:21 names a satisfying life, while 69:27 and 69:33 use being to recall former condition and conduct.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Life becomes livelihood, dwelling, social rank, bad condition, guarantorship, submission, and the elder whose identity is narrated through what he once was.

parent_channels.name: P2: Vertical rank moves between dominance and recovery

subchannels.name: Arrogant ascent and coercive superiority
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent turns elevation into mastery over others.
subchannels.active_motifs: العظمة والتجبر (`quranic:root_001042:B003/m01`); الغلبة والاستيلاء (`quranic:root_001042:B004/m01`); السلاطة قوة قاهرة مسلطة (`quranic:root_000732:B001/m01`); السلطان قدرة وولاية (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); الدناءة والضعة (`quranic:root_000493:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Arrogant elevation, dominance, coercive capacity, delegated rule, and social baseness establish a hierarchy whose upper and lower positions are ethically charged.

subchannels.name: Upward summons and elevated implement
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upper point or tool-position organizes approach and work.
subchannels.active_motifs: نداء التعالي (`quranic:root_001042:B006/m01`); أسماء الأدوات والأجزاء المرتفعة (`quranic:root_001042:B009/m01`); حرف عَلَى وما جرى مجراه (`quranic:root_001042:B012/m01`); الحَضيض قرار الأرض (`quranic:root_000334:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The call 'come up,' anvil or raised spear-part, the preposition 'upon,' and low ground at a mountain foot form a vertical coordinate system. Command, tool, grammar, and terrain all locate action relative to upper and lower.

subchannels.name: Recovery as rising from illness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body leaves a lowered state and regains health and standing.
subchannels.active_motifs: السلامة من النفاس أو العلة (`quranic:root_001042:B011/m01`); الإرضاء طلب رضا الغير وإزالة سخطه (`quranic:root_000569:B004/m01`); الفراغ والتمام والانقضاء (`quranic:root_001237:B004/m01`); هناءة بلا مشقة ولا وخامة (`quranic:root_001604:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Recovery after childbirth or illness, active pleasing, completion of a condition, and untroubled well-being describe healing as ascent out of impairment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Height can signify honor, coercive superiority, an upper tool-position, a summons upward, or recovery from a lowered bodily state.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:22 locates the garden high, while 69:33 names divine greatness and 69:34 the socially lowly poor person.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The vertical field reaches tyrannical ascent, mastery, a call to approach, anvil and spear-tip, prepositional 'upon,' low ground at a mountain foot, baseness, and rising after illness.

parent_channels.name: P2: Hunting turns landscape into trap and prey

subchannels.name: Hunter's screen, feeding bow, snare, and prey
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter conceals approach, sets or uses an implement, and captures an animal for food.
subchannels.active_motifs: الذريعة سبب وسترة (`quranic:root_000512:B005/m01`); آلة الصيد التي تطعم صاحبها (`quranic:root_000934:B006/m01`); المَصالي أشراك وفخوخ (`quranic:root_000880:B005/m01`); الفريسة والمعدة للأكل (`quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`); السبع الحيوان المفترس (`quranic:root_000669:B002/m01`); السلوف من النصال (`quranic:root_000733:B014/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Animal used as a shooting screen, bow or raptor that feeds its owner, trap, prepared prey, predator, and long arrowhead form a complete hunting mechanism from approach to captured food.

subchannels.name: Snake, pigeon, grass, and pasture edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small animals move through the vegetation that feeds or conceals them.
subchannels.active_motifs: الجان حية (`quranic:root_000266:B012/m01`); الحمام الطائر (`quranic:root_000001:B012/m01`); الخلى والحشيش المقطوع (`quranic:root_000436:B013/m01`); الصِّليان نبت ترعاه الإبل (`quranic:root_000880:B010/m01`); نبات رخص عريض الورق (`quranic:root_001241:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Snake, pigeon, cut fresh grass, pasture plant, and edible broad-leaf growth form a field-edge ecology. The same vegetation may be forage, cover, or gathered food depending on the participant.

subchannels.name: Animal and implement named by bodily shape
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible bodily proportion supplies names for animal, vessel, or tool.
subchannels.active_motifs: أسماء بعلامة الذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B012/m01`); اسم على شكل أو هيئة مخصوصة (`quranic:root_001372:B002/m01`); السالفة من العنق (`quranic:root_000733:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Names derived from an arm-mark, the hooked eagle or bucket form, and the front or side of the neck classify objects by bodily silhouette. Shape becomes a practical naming instrument within the hunting landscape.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A hunter uses concealment, lure, implement, and terrain to convert an animal into available food.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the punitive food scene activates the lexical distinction between nourishment, prey, and the mechanisms that procure it.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene reaches camel-screen, prey-producing bow, snare, prepared victim, snake, pigeon, cut grass, pasture plant, and edible leafy growth.

parent_channels.name: P3: The oath spans sight, insight, and certain truth

subchannels.name: Eye, inward sight, and hidden report
subchannels.scene_or_process: Perception moves from opened eye to penetrating understanding and then confronts claims about what cannot be seen.
subchannels.active_motifs: إبصار العين (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); بصيرة القلب (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); علم دقيق وفطنة (`quranic:root_000798:B005/m01`); انكشاف الشيء للعارف (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); الكاهن المتكهن بالأخبار الخفية (`quranic:root_001327:B001/m01`); تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ocular sight, inward insight, fine awareness, disclosed knowledge, divinatory report, and believing assent distinguish modes of access to reality. The hidden is not collapsed into the visible; rather, the source and reliability of each report become the issue.

subchannels.name: Blood trace, shield, seam, and readable surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface bears marks or joins that disclose injury, protection, or construction to an examiner.
subchannels.active_motifs: بصيرة الدم (`quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`); بصيرة السلاح (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`); غلظ الحافة ووصل الشقتين (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`); حجارة بصرة رخوة (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m01`); أثر يميز الشيء ويهدي إليه (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); شق ظاهر في الشفة العليا (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`); علامة مشعرة وشعيرة نسك (`quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Blood trail, shield, thick edge, stitched skins, bright soft stone, guiding mark, split upper lip, and ritual or battle sign create a forensic field. Surfaces do not merely appear; they carry evidence of what happened and how the body or object was made.

subchannels.name: Sworn division and distributed testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: An oath allocates responsibility and binds speakers to a claim before an audience.
subchannels.active_motifs: إفراز النصيب وتقسيم الشيء (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`); يمين مقسومة على أهلها (`quranic:root_001226:B004/m01`); بال مقسم بين وجوه الأمر (`quranic:root_001226:B006/m01`); هدنة قسامة (`quranic:root_001226:B008/m01`); يمين الحلف (`quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`); إخراج القول بالنطق (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); استغراق النفي (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Division into shares, oath, deliberative apportionment, truce, sworn pledge, voiced statement, and all-inclusive 'anyone' place testimony in a social procedure. Responsibility is distributed, but the uttered claim binds every participating voice.

subchannels.name: Fixed reality and certainty beyond doubt
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition is verified, made binding, and known with a stability that displaces doubt.
subchannels.active_motifs: ثبات مطابق للواقع ضد الباطل (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); لزوم واجب واستحقاق ثابت (`quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`); إثبات الحق وإظهاره (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`); ثبات العلم وزوال الشك (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`); تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); انكشاف الشيء للعارف (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); حجب الحق (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Reality, obligation, demonstration, settled certainty, assent, knowledge, and the act of covering truth form the final epistemic contrast. Certainty is not intensity alone: it is the convergence of true object, valid proof, receptive knower, and failed concealment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The assertion is secured across sensory visibility, inward recognition, sworn testimony, and knowledge from which doubt has been removed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:38-39 swears by the visible and invisible, 69:49 declares divine knowledge of deniers, and 69:51 names the truth of certainty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Evidence is materialized as blood-trace, shield, stitched hide, road-mark, and bright stone, so seeing becomes a practice of reading surfaces and protections.

parent_channels.name: P3: Authorized speech descends through a trusted carrier

subchannels.name: Messenger, carried saying, and measured delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bearer receives an utterance and conveys it with deliberate pace and fidelity.
subchannels.active_motifs: الإرسال والانبعاث (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); الرسول والرسالة (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); السير السهل واللين (`quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`); الرفق والتؤدة (`quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`); المراسلة والمسايرة (`quranic:root_000563:B008/m01`); إخراج القول بالنطق (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); الشرف والجود المحمود (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); العزيز الذي يكرم عليك (`quranic:root_001294:B010/m01`); رباني الملاحين (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Dispatch, messenger, carried statement, easy gait, deliberation, paired performance, voiced saying, honor, dear entrusted object, and captaincy create a reliable delivery scene. The bearer is valued because movement, speech, and custodial role remain aligned.

subchannels.name: Descent, placement, and repeated revelation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Content moves from higher source to lower reception and is placed in its proper rank.
subchannels.active_motifs: هبوط الشيء وحلوله (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); إنزال الشيء وإيصاله (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); وضع الشيء في منزلته (`quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`); النزلة الواحدة (`quranic:root_001492:B010/m01`); ربوبية وملك وسيادة (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); إصلاح وتربية وإتمام (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); انكشاف الشيء للعارف (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); العلو والارتفاع (`quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`); السماء وما علا فأظل (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Descent, caused descent, ordered placement, single descent-event, lordship, gradual cultivation, knowledge, height, and sky establish a vertical transmission process. Repetition does not weaken the source; it distributes the content in an ordered way appropriate to the receiver.

subchannels.name: Prepared reception and honored provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recipient is treated like a guest for whom a suitable place and provision have been prepared.
subchannels.active_motifs: المنزل والمنزلة (`quranic:root_001492:B003/m01`); النزل المعد للنازل (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); الشرف والجود المحمود (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); هدية تطلب المكافأة (`quranic:root_001294:B008/m01`); جواب الرضا والكرامة (`quranic:root_001294:B009/m01`); الرخاء وطيب الإعطاء (`quranic:root_000563:B010/m01`); إصلاح وتربية وإتمام (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Dwelling and rank, guest-provision, generosity, gift seeking return, gracious response, ease of giving, and careful cultivation frame revelation as prepared reception. The image pressures the audience: refusing the message resembles refusing provision fitted to the guest.

subchannels.name: Bearer's honor versus competitive self-display
subchannels.scene_or_process: True honor rests in the entrusted role, while rivalry seeks to manufacture rank through comparison.
subchannels.active_motifs: الشرف والجود المحمود (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); مفاخرة الكرم والغلبة فيه (`quranic:root_001294:B006/m01`); العزيز الذي يكرم عليك (`quranic:root_001294:B010/m01`); المساماة والمباراة (`quranic:root_000745:B007/m01`); الصيت الحسن المنتشر (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); التعاظم والزهو (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); الحرمة والشرف (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Intrinsic nobility and a cherished trust contrast with competitive claims to generosity, rivalry in elevation, public good name, self-aggrandizement, and social dignity. The messenger's honor is relational and custodial rather than self-created.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A valid message has an originating authority, an ordered descent, an honored bearer, and a speech act that preserves rather than invents its charge.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:40 identifies the speech of an honored messenger, and 69:43 identifies its descent from the Lord of the worlds.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Transmission is rendered as release, carried saying, measured gait, repeated descent, assigned rank, guest-provision, and a shipmaster who keeps the course.

parent_channels.name: P3: Poetry and divination are rival production systems

subchannels.name: Metered poem, poet, and segmented line
subchannels.scene_or_process: A craftsperson composes measured language whose units can be divided and compared.
subchannels.active_motifs: قريض وشاعر (`quranic:root_000798:B007/m01`); كلام وشعر مقطع (`quranic:root_001240:B022/m01`); إخراج القول بالنطق (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); كثرة القول في صاحبه (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); تجزئة الشيء وطائفته (`quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`); إفراز النصيب وتقسيم الشيء (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Poetry, poet, segmented verse, clipped speech, utterance, fluent speaker, part, and division describe a made verbal object. The denial identifies a genuine production system but excludes it as the source of this saying.

subchannels.name: Fine awareness, sign, and bodily slogan
subchannels.scene_or_process: Subtle perception is externalized as a sign worn close to body or displayed in ritual and conflict.
subchannels.active_motifs: شعار يلاصق الجسد (`quranic:root_000798:B004/m01`); علم دقيق وفطنة (`quranic:root_000798:B005/m01`); علامة مشعرة وشعيرة نسك (`quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`); أثر يميز الشيء ويهدي إليه (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); جريان الذكر على اللسان (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Undergarment or inward slogan, fine awareness, ritual or battle mark, guiding sign, and spoken mention move between inner apprehension and public emblem. The scene shows why poetic and prophetic language can be confused: both make the barely perceived socially visible.

subchannels.name: Hair, dense vegetation, and grain-scale analogy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fine repeated growth supplies material analogies for texture, density, and small units.
subchannels.active_motifs: الشَّعر النابت وما عليه زغب (`quranic:root_000798:B001/m01`); نبات كثيف كالشَّعر (`quranic:root_000798:B002/m01`); حبة الشعير وما يشبهها (`quranic:root_000798:B003/m01`); جودة النبات والغيث (`quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`); العنب والكرمة (`quranic:root_001294:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hair and down, hair-like dense vegetation, barley grain, fertile rain-bearing land, and grapevine create a scale from filament to field. Poetic vocabulary is grounded in inspectable natural forms rather than free-floating ornament.

subchannels.name: Soothsayer, hidden information, and assigned service
subchannels.scene_or_process: A specialist claims access to concealed reports and may act as an attendant within a social group.
subchannels.active_motifs: الكاهن المتكهن بالأخبار الخفية (`quranic:root_001327:B001/m01`); الكاهن القائم بأمر الرجل (`quranic:root_001327:B002/m01`); الكاهنان لقب لقبيلتين (`quranic:root_001327:B003/m01`); انكشاف الشيء للعارف (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); أثر يميز الشيء ويهدي إليه (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); أسماء مخصوصة منقولة (`quranic:root_000798:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden-news diviner, appointed attendant, tribal title, knowledge, distinguishing mark, and transferred proper names define the social institution of soothsaying. The denial separates revelation from both speculative access and inherited office.

subchannels.name: Particle, definition, and formal language
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is organized by small grammatical operators and explicit delimitation of meaning.
subchannels.active_motifs: حرف رب وربما (`quranic:root_000532:B015/m01`); قول الشيء حده (`quranic:root_001272:B016/m01`); الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The particle `rubba`, logical definition, and naming form a formal language layer beneath extended utterance. These devices organize reference and scope without themselves identifying the message's source.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Poetic composition and divinatory report have their own materials, marks, meters, and social agents, but they do not explain the message's source.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:41-42 explicitly denies that the speech belongs to a poet or soothsayer.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Poetry's root reaches hair, vegetation, barley, undergarment, blood-mark, star-name, and segmented meter; divination reaches hidden news, service, and tribal title.

parent_channels.name: P3: Fabrication is exposed as attributed and circulating speech

subchannels.name: Invented saying and false attribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker composes what was not said and attaches it to an authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: قول ما لم يكن أو نسبته (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); اجترار القول إلى النفس (`quranic:root_001272:B006/m01`); خلاف الصدق (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); نسبة الشيء أو صاحبه إلى الكذب (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); كلام وشعر مقطع (`quranic:root_001240:B022/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication, appropriation of a saying, lie, accusation of lying, and clipped or segmented speech define authorship fraud. The counterfactual is precise because both production and attribution must occur for the offense to exist.

subchannels.name: Circulating report, name, and public reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech detaches from its first speaker and becomes a social current of praise, blame, or rumor.
subchannels.active_motifs: كثرة القول في صاحبه (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); القول الفاشي بين الناس (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); المقاولة في الأمر (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); جريان الذكر على اللسان (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); ذكر المرء شرف وصيت (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`); الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); الصيت الحسن المنتشر (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); هدية تطلب المكافأة (`quranic:root_001294:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fluent speaker, circulating talk, negotiation, mention, renown, name, favorable reputation, and gift seeking reward through praise form a publicity system. False attribution gains force only if this circulation carries it.

subchannels.name: Failed continuation as embodied untruth
subchannels.scene_or_process: An action's course contradicts its apparent promise by halting, disappearing, or failing under pressure.
subchannels.active_motifs: صدق الحملة أو كذبها (`quranic:root_001290:B004/m01`); ما كذب أن فعل أي ما لبث (`quranic:root_001290:B005/m01`); كذب لبن الناقة إذا ذهب ولم يدم (`quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`); كذب الوحشي إذا جرى ثم وقف (`quranic:root_001290:B007/m01`); عجز وانقطاع عن فعل (`quranic:root_001240:B020/m01`); الحَسير منقطع القوة (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: A charge that falters, action without delay, milk that vanishes, an animal that runs then stops, inability to continue, and exhausted power make 'lying' visible as a failed trajectory. The body and event expose what the initial appearance falsely promised.

subchannels.name: Deceptive surface and resistant inner self
subchannels.scene_or_process: An outer pattern or covering misstates what lies beneath while the self sustains the deception.
subchannels.active_motifs: النفس الكذوب (`quranic:root_001290:B008/m01`); الكذابة ثوب يكذب بحاله (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); ستر وتغطية (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); حجب الحق (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); غلظ الحافة ووصل الشقتين (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`); قول في النفس لم يظهر (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); القول اعتقاد ومذهب (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`); قول الشيء حده (`quranic:root_001272:B016/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Deceptive self, multicolored cloth, covering, covered truth, stitched surface, inward statement, adopted doctrine, and formal definition distinguish outer sign from inner commitment. Exposure requires reading both layers.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: False discourse is produced by inventing words, assigning them to another, circulating them socially, and resisting the marks that disclose their source.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:44-47 imagines fabricated sayings attributed to God, and 69:49 names those who deny.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lie reaches a failed military charge, stopping animal, vanished milk, painted cloth, rumor, logical definition, and the act of cutting speech into misleading fragments.

parent_channels.name: P3: Seizure culminates in severing the lifeline

subchannels.name: Taking by force and arresting grip
subchannels.scene_or_process: A superior agent seizes the body at a usable hold and prevents counteraction.
subchannels.active_motifs: حوز الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); المؤاخذة بالذنب (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); القبض والأسر (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); أخذة المصارعة (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); مقبض الشيء المأخوذ به (`quranic:root_000018:B012/m01`); اليد اليمنى والجهة اليمنى (`quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`); يمين القوة والحق (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); آلة قاطعة وحد أو نصل (`quranic:root_001240:B014/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Taking, accountability, capture, wrestling hold, handle, right hand, effective force, and cutting implement form the initial interception. Power is not abstract: it reaches the body through a grip and an edge.

subchannels.name: Aorta, fixed life-channel, and fatal cut
subchannels.scene_or_process: A persistent conduit supplies the body until a precise cut terminates life.
subchannels.active_motifs: ثبات وملازمة (`quranic:root_001622:B001/m01`); الوتين عرق الحياة (`quranic:root_001622:B002/m01`); إصابة الوتين (`quranic:root_001622:B003/m01`); غلظ وتين الإبل (`quranic:root_001622:B005/m01`); الصَّرْم والإبانة (`quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`); انقطاع وذهاب ونهاية (`quranic:root_001240:B005/m01`); فصل أمر أو حق (`quranic:root_001240:B010/m01`); طعنة استقامت حتى نفذت (`quranic:root_000347:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Persistence, the life-artery, injury to it, its bodily thickening, severance, termination, decisive separation of a matter, and a straight penetrating thrust define a targeted fatal mechanism. Cutting the conduit abolishes the continuity that had sustained the whole body.

subchannels.name: Choking, inner rupture, and exhausted breath
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life is also stopped by constricting the airway or producing catastrophic internal interruption.
subchannels.active_motifs: اختناق وقطع النفس (`quranic:root_001240:B009/m01`); مغص وبهر وانقطاع باطن (`quranic:root_001240:B021/m01`); انقباض الأمعاء من الظمأ (`quranic:root_000297:B008/m01`); الحَسير منقطع القوة (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Noose and stopped breath, abdominal pain and panting, thirst-contracted intestines, and exhausted capacity show several bodily routes to the same terminal outcome. The surface selects the aorta, but the lexical field maps the wider physiology of interruption.

subchannels.name: No person, barrier, or kin-group can intervene
subchannels.scene_or_process: Every possible intermediary is excluded from standing between agent and target.
subchannels.active_motifs: الأَحَدِيَّة والوَحْدَة (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`); استغراق النفي (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); الانفراد والتفرق آحادا (`quranic:root_000017:B005/m01`); الحيلولة بفاصل (`quranic:root_000297:B001/m01`); إيقاف القتال بالمحاجزة (`quranic:root_000297:B002/m01`); حجز الرجل أصله وعشيرته (`quranic:root_000297:B006/m01`); انقطاع الرجاء والسفر (`quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`); هجر وصريمة وقطع وصل (`quranic:root_001240:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: One person, anyone under total negation, separated individuals, physical barrier, fight-stopper, clan refuge, stranded traveler, and broken social bond enumerate possible interposers. None can convert the seizure into truce, rescue, or renewed connection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Punitive interception moves from taking by superior force to cutting the vital conduit and foreclosing every intervention.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:45-47 describes taking by the right, cutting the aorta, and the inability of anyone to block the act.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The vital mechanism expands into grip, straight thrust, choking rope, abdominal rupture, severed hope, and the persistent vessel whose life ends when its fixed channel is cut.

parent_channels.name: P3: Protection can cover, gird, or fail

subchannels.name: Shield, armor, and guarded body
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protective layer intercepts injury before it reaches flesh.
subchannels.active_motifs: دفع الضرر بوقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); جعل النفس في وقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); بصيرة السلاح (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`); الحاسر عار من الوقاية (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`); ستر وتغطية (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); تاج يغطي (`quranic:root_001307:B015/m01`); شعار يلاصق الجسد (`quranic:root_000798:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Protection, self-guarding, shield, unarmored exposure, covering, crown, and body-clinging garment define defense at the skin boundary. The bare fighter reveals by contrast what the protective layer normally does.

subchannels.name: Belt, tether, and fitted restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding member secures clothing, load, or animal body by joining it to a stable point.
subchannels.active_motifs: شد الوسط وحجزة اللباس (`quranic:root_000297:B004/m01`); رباط البعير المحجوز (`quranic:root_000297:B005/m01`); دفع الضرر بوقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Waistband, camel tether, and protective barrier share fastening mechanics. Function distinguishes aid from coercion: the same fitted restraint can keep a load safe or prevent a body from moving.

subchannels.name: Clan refuge, chastity, and social guarding
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is protected by lineage, reputation, and controlled bodily boundaries.
subchannels.active_motifs: حجز الرجل أصله وعشيرته (`quranic:root_000297:B006/m01`); الحجزة كناية عن العفة (`quranic:root_000297:B007/m01`); موضع منقطع (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); ثنية مستورة (`quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`); الانفراد والتفرق آحادا (`quranic:root_000017:B005/m01`); جعل النفس في وقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Clan origin, chastity, remote protected settlement, hidden mountain pass, individual separation, and self-guarding move defense from armor to social geography and conduct. Refuge works by controlling access.

subchannels.name: Cautious footing, measured weight, and warning bird
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vulnerable traveler avoids injury by testing surface, load, and environmental sign.
subchannels.active_motifs: توقي الدابة من وجع الحافر (`quranic:root_001677:B003/m01`); الأوقية وزن معلوم (`quranic:root_001677:B004/m01`); الواقي اسم للصرد (`quranic:root_001677:B005/m01`); حجارة بصرة رخوة (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m01`); عبور مسافة أو ماء (`quranic:root_001240:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: A horse protecting a sore hoof, a known weight, a warning bird, soft pale stones, and a water crossing form a practical risk scene. Guarding is anticipatory perception translated into careful motion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Defense places a material or social layer between vulnerability and harm, but that layer can be stripped, bypassed, or become a restraint itself.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:47 denies any effective barrier, while 69:48 addresses those who actively guard themselves.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Protection reaches shield, armor, belt, animal tether, garment, seed-cover, clan, chastity, cautious hoof, and a crown that covers the ruler.

parent_channels.name: P3: Reminder makes an inward trace publicly legible

subchannels.name: Retention, recollection, and active prompting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stored content is brought back into attention and offered as a prompt to conduct.
subchannels.active_motifs: استحضار الشيء بعد النسيان أو مع الحفظ (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); الذكرى والتذكرة ما يذكّر (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); انكشاف الشيء للعارف (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); جعل النفس في وقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Retention against forgetting, reminder, knowledge, assent, and self-guarding form the cognitive-behavioral sequence. The reminder succeeds when recovered content becomes anticipatory protection.

subchannels.name: Spoken mention, honor, and durable deed
subchannels.scene_or_process: Memory is externalized as repeated name, public reputation, or written evidence of a right.
subchannels.active_motifs: جريان الذكر على اللسان (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); ذكر المرء شرف وصيت (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`); ذكر الحق صك ووثيقة حق (`quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`); الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); الصيت الحسن المنتشر (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); أثر يميز الشيء ويهدي إليه (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mention, renown, deed of right, name, favorable reputation, and identifying mark carry memory outside an individual mind. They let later observers recognize a person, claim, or path.

subchannels.name: Ritual sign, bodily mark, and counted remembrance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible or tactile token cues communal identity and repeated devotional action.
subchannels.active_motifs: علامة مشعرة وشعيرة نسك (`quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`); أثر يميز الشيء ويهدي إليه (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); شق ظاهر في الشفة العليا (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`); خرز التسبيح (`quranic:root_000666:B006/m01`); الذكر خلاف الأنثى (`quranic:root_000516:B001/m01`); صلابة الذكر وحدته وشدته (`quranic:root_000516:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ritual or battle sign, guiding mark, split lip, counting beads, male classification, and hard masculine material show remembrance embodied in tokens. Mark and repetition keep identity available to eye, hand, and community.

subchannels.name: Proper name and transferred location
subchannels.scene_or_process: A lexical form preserves identity by becoming the stable name of person, star, mountain, or place.
subchannels.active_motifs: أسماء مخصوصة منقولة (`quranic:root_000798:B008/m01`); الأول والإضافة (`quranic:root_000017:B004/m01`); جبل أُحُد (`quranic:root_000017:B006/m01`); العزيز الذي يكرم عليك (`quranic:root_001294:B010/m01`); الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Transferred star, mountain, clan, and personal names; Sunday as the first day; Mount Uhud; cherished person; and name itself turn memory into a fixed index. A proper name is a compact reminder whose referent must still be correctly identified.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Remembering preserves content in the heart, reactivates it through speech or sign, and leaves a durable mark that can guide later recognition.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:42 contrasts little remembrance with soothsaying, and 69:48 calls the message a reminder for the self-guarding.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The reminder becomes a legal deed, male hardness, honor, battle-sign, road-marker, inscribed edge, prayer bead, and named star or mountain.

parent_channels.name: P3: Covering truth matures into exposure and regret

subchannels.name: Cover, darkness, and obscured truth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A layer hides object, light, gratitude, or acknowledged reality from view.
subchannels.active_motifs: ستر وتغطية (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); غمر ساتر (`quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`); حجب الحق (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); ستر النعمة (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`); الحَسْر كشف الغطاء وإزالة الساتر (`quranic:root_000320:B001/m01`); إبصار العين (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); بصيرة القلب (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Covering, darkness or engulfing water, concealment of truth, concealment of benefit, and the act of stripping a cover frame the conflict between visibility and denial. Eye and insight specify what the cover prevents.

subchannels.name: Uncovering, armorless exposure, and exhausted perception
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protective or obscuring layers recede until body and sight stand without reserve.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحَسْر كشف الغطاء وإزالة الساتر (`quranic:root_000320:B001/m01`); الحاسر عار من الوقاية (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`); الحَسير منقطع القوة (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`); ستر وتغطية (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); دفع الضرر بوقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); إبصار العين (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cloud or sea is swept aside, the fighter is left without armor, vision and strength run out, and the ordinary cover is gone. Protection is conceptually present only as what failed to remain between subject and consequence.

subchannels.name: Molting, bodily reduction, and social exclusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loss of covering appears as shed hair or feather, reduced flesh, and exclusion from protected spaces.
subchannels.active_motifs: التحسر سقوط الريش والشعر وانضواء اللحم (`quranic:root_000320:B005/m01`); المُحَسَّر محقر مقصى (`quranic:root_000320:B006/m01`); موضع منقطع (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); الشَّعر النابت وما عليه زغب (`quranic:root_000798:B001/m01`); انقطاع الرجاء والسفر (`quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Molting feather, lost hair, tightened flesh, banishment from royal doors, remote settlement or grave, body hair, and stranded traveler make exposure both physiological and social. What is lost is a layer of belonging as much as a physical covering.

subchannels.name: Regret for the lost and attempted covering of fault
subchannels.scene_or_process: The exposed person grieves an irrecoverable loss while lexical expiation imagines fault being covered in another, reparative mode.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحَسرة تلهف على فائت (`quranic:root_000320:B004/m01`); تبرؤ وتنصل (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); نسبة إلى الكفر (`quranic:root_001307:B006/m01`); إلجاء إلى العصيان (`quranic:root_001307:B007/m01`); محو الإثم بتغطيته (`quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`); خضوع متطامن (`quranic:root_001307:B014/m01`); نسبة الشيء أو صاحبه إلى الكذب (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Regret, disavowal, accusation of unbelief, coercion into disobedience, expiation, submissive bowing, and accusation of lying map responses after fault becomes visible. Covering truth and covering sin are opposite operations: one prevents acknowledgment, the other seeks accountable repair.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Concealment initially blocks recognition, but removal of the cover leaves the denier exposed, exhausted, and grieving what cannot be recovered.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:49-50 joins knowledge of deniers to the message becoming regret for them.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The process reaches cloud clearing, receding sea, bare armorless body, molting feathers, depleted gaze, remote grave, covered seed, and expiation that attempts to cover fault differently.

parent_channels.name: P3: Sacred elevation resolves into naming and praise

subchannels.name: Lordship, cultivation, and sacred knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sovereignty is joined to the patient work of sustaining, teaching, and ordering what is under care.
subchannels.active_motifs: ربوبية وملك وسيادة (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); إصلاح وتربية وإتمام (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); علم رباني (`quranic:root_000532:B003/m01`); ربابة عهد وميثاق (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); رباني الملاحين (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); انكشاف الشيء للعارف (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); الكبر والقوة (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); الحرمة والشرف (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship, gradual cultivation, learned devotion, covenant, captaincy, knowledge, greatness, and sacred dignity frame authority as both superior and sustaining. The name in the final command belongs to a relation of care, not merely force.

subchannels.name: Greatness, awe, and rejection of self-magnification
subchannels.scene_or_process: True magnitude evokes reverence, while human self-enlargement distorts scale.
subchannels.active_motifs: الكبر والقوة (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); معظم الشيء (`quranic:root_001029:B002/m01`); العظيمة النازلة (`quranic:root_001029:B004/m01`); التعاظم والزهو (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); الاستعظام والهيبة (`quranic:root_001029:B007/m01`); الحرمة والشرف (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`); العلو والارتفاع (`quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`); الشخص المرتفع الظاهر (`quranic:root_000745:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Magnitude, major portion, overwhelming calamity, arrogance, awe, honor, height, and visible elevated figure distinguish objective greatness from performed self-aggrandizement. Praise restores the scale that pride falsifies.

subchannels.name: Name, elevated reputation, and incomparable rank
subchannels.scene_or_process: Naming makes exalted identity present in speech without reducing it to a visible body.
subchannels.active_motifs: الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); المساماة والمباراة (`quranic:root_000745:B007/m01`); الصيت الحسن المنتشر (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); الشرف والجود المحمود (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); العزيز الذي يكرم عليك (`quranic:root_001294:B010/m01`); انفراد بلا نظير (`quranic:root_001240:B018/m01`); الأَحَدِيَّة والوَحْدَة (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Name, rivalry in elevation, good renown, nobility, cherished uniqueness, unmatched rank, and oneness establish identity through distinction. The final naming act is praise precisely because the referent exceeds competitors and substitutes.

subchannels.name: Purification, worship, and expansive motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Praise clears defect from the named one and releases the worshipper into repeated devotional movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: العبادة بالتسبيح والصلاة (`quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`); التنزيه والتبرئة (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`); السبح في الجري والعوم (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); السعة للذهاب والمعاش (`quranic:root_000666:B005/m01`); خرز التسبيح (`quranic:root_000666:B006/m01`); سباح الجلود والكساء (`quranic:root_000666:B007/m01`); سبوحة الموضع (`quranic:root_000666:B008/m01`); جريان الذكر على اللسان (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Prayer, purification from defect, swimming or running, freedom to move for livelihood, counting beads, strong ritual clothing, sacred place, and spoken mention turn glorification into embodied practice. Motion and material token prevent praise from remaining an unperformed abstraction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Divine transcendence is articulated through lordship, greatness, elevated name, purification from defect, worship, and grateful movement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 69:43 names the Lord as source, and 69:52 commands glorification through the name of the great Lord.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Praise reaches prayer, voluntary worship, counted beads, running and swimming, strong leather garments, holy locations, cloud-canopy, and the leader of sailors.

parent_channels.name: P3: Quantity is formed by part, share, one, and few

subchannels.name: Part, severed piece, and distributed share
subchannels.scene_or_process: A whole is divided into portions that can be assigned, carried, or judged separately.
subchannels.active_motifs: تجزئة الشيء وطائفته (`quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`); إفراز النصيب وتقسيم الشيء (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`); قطعة مفصولة وطائفة (`quranic:root_001240:B002/m01`); تفريق وتقسيم وتجزئة (`quranic:root_001240:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Part, allotted share, separated piece, and division into groups or kinds establish partition as both conceptual and material. The imagined 'some sayings' gains precision as a portion detached from a larger discourse.

subchannels.name: One, anyone, individual, and first position
subchannels.scene_or_process: Singularity can identify a unique unit, exhaust a negated class, or isolate individuals from a group.
subchannels.active_motifs: الأَحَدِيَّة والوَحْدَة (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`); استغراق النفي (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); الواحد في العد والتركيب (`quranic:root_000017:B003/m01`); الأول والإضافة (`quranic:root_000017:B004/m01`); الانفراد والتفرق آحادا (`quranic:root_000017:B005/m01`); انفراد بلا نظير (`quranic:root_001240:B018/m01`); ثبات وملازمة (`quranic:root_001622:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Unity, all-inclusive anyone, numerical one, first day, separated individuals, unmatched singularity, and persistence distinguish several roles for the unit. In the surface negation, one does not mean a privileged exception but exhaustive failure of every possible person.

subchannels.name: Fewness, summit, jar, load, and tremor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A root of small quantity unfolds into upper point, containing vessel, lifted burden, and a body's slight but visible disturbance.
subchannels.active_motifs: القِلَّة والضآلة (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); قُلَّة الشيء ورأسه (`quranic:root_001251:B002/m01`); القُلَّة الجرة الكبيرة (`quranic:root_001251:B003/m01`); الإقلال والاستقلال حملا ونهوضا (`quranic:root_001251:B004/m01`); القِلُّ رعدة واضطراب (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); حسن موزع في الوجه (`quranic:root_001226:B001/m01`); طي القسامي أول الثوب (`quranic:root_001226:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fewness, peak, large jar, carrying and departure, tremor, well-proportioned face, and first fold of cloth show quantity through scale, elevation, containment, motion, and form. The repeated 'little' sits within this broader calibration of how much is present or activated.

subchannels.name: Oath distributed across persons and outcomes
subchannels.scene_or_process: A collective claim is stabilized by assigning vows, shares, and responsibility among participants.
subchannels.active_motifs: يمين مقسومة على أهلها (`quranic:root_001226:B004/m01`); بال مقسم بين وجوه الأمر (`quranic:root_001226:B006/m01`); هدنة قسامة (`quranic:root_001226:B008/m01`); يمين الحلف (`quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`); المقاولة في الأمر (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Oath, divided deliberation, truce, sworn pledge, and negotiation form a social arithmetic. Speech is apportioned to responsible agents rather than left as an anonymous collective murmur.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A whole is analyzed through partition, allotted share, discrete unit, small amount, and singular identity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:41-42 repeats 'little,' 69:44 imagines some sayings, and 69:47 negates every single intervenor.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Quantification reaches water allocation, blood-oath distribution, large jars, mountain peaks, cloth-folding, tremor, Sunday, and isolated individuals.

parent_channels.name: P3: Conflict is interrupted, crossed, or concluded

subchannels.name: Challenge, duel, and competitive superiority
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents descend into direct contest and test strength, speed, or public excellence.
subchannels.active_motifs: النزول للمبارزة (`quranic:root_001492:B007/m01`); مفاخرة الكرم والغلبة فيه (`quranic:root_001294:B006/m01`); سبق وسرعة تترك وراءها (`quranic:root_001240:B017/m01`); انفراد بلا نظير (`quranic:root_001240:B018/m01`); أخذة المصارعة (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); بال مقسم بين وجوه الأمر (`quranic:root_001226:B006/m01`); الشدة النازلة (`quranic:root_001492:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Duel, descending calamity, rivalry in generosity, racing speed, unmatched capacity, wrestling hold, and tactical deliberation stage contest at bodily and reputational levels. The issue is who can carry action through rather than merely claim superiority.

subchannels.name: War sign, blood oath, and captured body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Combatants identify their side, bind themselves by oath, and seize an opponent.
subchannels.active_motifs: علامة مشعرة وشعيرة نسك (`quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`); يمين مقسومة على أهلها (`quranic:root_001226:B004/m01`); القبض والأسر (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); أخذة المصارعة (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); يمين القوة والحق (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); الحاسر عار من الوقاية (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Battle-sign, blood-oath, capture, wrestling grip, force, and armorless fighter form a close combat frame. Signs and vows organize collective violence before the grip individualizes it on a body.

subchannels.name: Road interception, crossing, and stranded traveler
subchannels.scene_or_process: Movement through a route is opposed, diverted, or broken by hostile control.
subchannels.active_motifs: عبور مسافة أو ماء (`quranic:root_001240:B003/m01`); ذهاب الطير ورجوعه بين البلاد (`quranic:root_001240:B004/m01`); انقطاع الرجاء والسفر (`quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`); قطع الطريق بالغصب والصد (`quranic:root_001240:B023/m01`); الحجاز الفاصل بين البلاد (`quranic:root_000297:B003/m01`); ثنية مستورة (`quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Water or road crossing, seasonal bird movement, stranded traveler, highway robbery, the separating Hijaz, and hidden mountain passage map conflict onto mobility. Control of route can isolate without direct bodily combat.

subchannels.name: Interposition, truce, and broken relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A third force may separate fighters and preserve peace, or separation may harden into abandonment.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحيلولة بفاصل (`quranic:root_000297:B001/m01`); إيقاف القتال بالمحاجزة (`quranic:root_000297:B002/m01`); هدنة قسامة (`quranic:root_001226:B008/m01`); هجر وصريمة وقطع وصل (`quranic:root_001240:B007/m01`); تبرؤ وتنصل (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Barrier, separation of combatants, truce, severed relation, and disavowal distinguish protective interruption from hostile rupture. The surface denial says no such mediator can halt the divine action.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Opposed parties move from challenge and capture through boundary crossing to intervention, truce, or severed relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:45-47 supplies seizure, fatal force, and failed intervention as a compact conflict scene.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Conflict reaches war-slogan, blood oath, duel, highway interception, migration, racing, clan refuge, garment-belt grip, and a geographic region named for separation.

parent_channels.name: P3: Garment construction makes covering inspectable

subchannels.name: Fold, seam, and joined hide
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flat material is folded and stitched so separate edges become one usable surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: طي القسامي أول الثوب (`quranic:root_001226:B007/m01`); غلظ الحافة ووصل الشقتين (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`); شعار يلاصق الجسد (`quranic:root_000798:B004/m01`); تفصيل ثوب ومقطعات (`quranic:root_001240:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: First fold, stitched hide, body-clinging undergarment, and tailored cloth define construction from initial lay to joined surface. The seam is visible evidence of how the covering was made.

subchannels.name: Cut garment, saddle layer, and fitted bodily form
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material is cut into pieces whose shape corresponds to body or load.
subchannels.active_motifs: تفصيل ثوب ومقطعات (`quranic:root_001240:B012/m01`); سوط وطاء مصنوعان من قطع (`quranic:root_001240:B015/m01`); شبه وقد وهيئة ممشوقة (`quranic:root_001240:B019/m01`); التحسر سقوط الريش والشعر وانضواء اللحم (`quranic:root_000320:B005/m01`); رأس الفخذ المستدير (`quranic:root_001294:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Tailored garment, segmented whip or saddle-cloth, proportioned bodily shape, reduced flesh after shedding, and the rounded hip-joint move between fabric pattern and anatomical fit. Cutting can produce a usable form rather than simply destroy.

subchannels.name: Waist fastening, armor cover, and protective clothing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A garment is secured at the body's middle and layered over vulnerable surfaces or equipment.
subchannels.active_motifs: شد الوسط وحجزة اللباس (`quranic:root_000297:B004/m01`); ستر وتغطية (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); تاج يغطي (`quranic:root_001307:B015/m01`); دفع الضرر بوقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); الحاسر عار من الوقاية (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`); سباح الجلود والكساء (`quranic:root_000666:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Waistband, cloth over armor, crown, protective barrier, exposed unarmored body, and strong leather clothing show covering as fitted defense and status. Fastening determines whether the layer remains functional under motion.

subchannels.name: Neck ornament, vessel lid, and ceremonial finish
subchannels.scene_or_process: A finished object receives an upper closure or ornament that signals completion and rank.
subchannels.active_motifs: الكَرْم المنظوم في العنق (`quranic:root_001294:B003/m01`); طبق على رأس الوعاء (`quranic:root_001294:B005/m01`); تاج يغطي (`quranic:root_001307:B015/m01`); الشخص المرتفع الظاهر (`quranic:root_000745:B002/m01`); الحرمة والشرف (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Necklace, lid over jar or pot, crown, elevated visible figure, and dignity place finish at the upper boundary. Closure and ornament both announce that the object or wearer has been deliberately completed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Textile is produced through folding, stitching, cutting, fitting, fastening, and covering a body or vessel.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the visible/invisible oath and the stripping of every possible defense make surfaces and coverings semantically active.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The craft reaches hide sewn to hide, first fold, tailored pieces, saddle-cloth, waistband, necklace, vessel lid, leather children's clothes, and royal crown.

parent_channels.name: P3: Water descends, gathers, and is crossed

subchannels.name: Cloud, sky, and released rain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water gathers overhead and is sent down from an elevated cover.
subchannels.active_motifs: رباب السحاب (`quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`); السماء وما علا فأظل (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); هبوط الشيء وحلوله (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); إنزال الشيء وإيصاله (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); الإرسال والانبعاث (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); جودة النبات والغيث (`quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Layered cloud, sky and rain, descent, caused descent, dispatch, and fertile rain-bearing ground form a complete precipitation scene. Sending and descending translate source authority into material delivery.

subchannels.name: Great water, well, and engulfing darkness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water gathers at a scale that can sustain, conceal, or overwhelm.
subchannels.active_motifs: ماء كثير مجتمع في عيلم (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); ماء رَبَب كثير (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); غمر ساتر (`quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`); الحَسْر كشف الغطاء وإزالة الساتر (`quranic:root_000320:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Great sea or abundant well, plentiful water, oceanic or nocturnal covering, and sea receding from shore describe mass water through depth, concealment, and withdrawal. What becomes visible depends on the water's level.

subchannels.name: Allocated flow and water crossing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body of water is divided into usable shares or traversed along a controlled line.
subchannels.active_motifs: إفراز النصيب وتقسيم الشيء (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`); عبور مسافة أو ماء (`quranic:root_001240:B003/m01`); انقطاع وذهاب ونهاية (`quranic:root_001240:B005/m01`); السبح في الجري والعوم (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); الأوقية وزن معلوم (`quranic:root_001677:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Apportioned water, river crossing, water's endpoint, swimming, and known weight make hydrology measurable. Share, route, termination, bodily motion, and load determine whether the water supports or obstructs passage.

subchannels.name: Roaming over land and water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Living bodies move freely through a broad medium until a route or resource ends.
subchannels.active_motifs: السبح في الجري والعوم (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); السعة للذهاب والمعاش (`quranic:root_000666:B005/m01`); ذهاب الطير ورجوعه بين البلاد (`quranic:root_001240:B004/m01`); انقطاع الرجاء والسفر (`quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`); سبق وسرعة تترك وراءها (`quranic:root_001240:B017/m01`); الانفراد والتفرق آحادا (`quranic:root_000017:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Swimming, running, free movement for livelihood, bird migration, stranded travel, racing speed, and individual dispersal form a mobility field spanning water and land. Freedom is defined by available medium and sustained provision.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The water cycle runs from cloud and descent to gathered mass, allocated share, travel across it, and receding exposure of what lay beneath.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:38-39's visible and invisible range and 69:43's descent activate material images of rain, sea, and crossing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hydrology reaches lordly cloud, great well, oceanic darkness, apportioned irrigation, swimming, bird migration, and a route that ends when water or provisions fail.

parent_channels.name: P3: Cultivation alternates cover, emergence, and harvest economy

subchannels.name: Covered seed and emerging crop
subchannels.scene_or_process: The cultivator hides seed in soil so rain can convert concealment into visible growth.
subchannels.active_motifs: تغطية البذر (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); جودة النبات والغيث (`quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`); العنب والكرمة (`quranic:root_001294:B004/m01`); نبات كثيف كالشَّعر (`quranic:root_000798:B002/m01`); حبة الشعير وما يشبهها (`quranic:root_000798:B003/m01`); إنزال الشيء وإيصاله (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); ربة نبات (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Farmer covering seed, fertile rain, vine, dense vegetation, barley grain, descending water, and persistent green plant form the sowing-to-growth sequence. Concealment is productive here because it prepares emergence rather than suppressing truth.

subchannels.name: Fruit sheath, perfume, and prepared yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Produce matures inside a cover and is transformed into valued food, scent, or guest provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: كمام الثمر (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); كافور طيب (`quranic:root_001307:B011/m01`); النزل المعد للنازل (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); العنب والكرمة (`quranic:root_001294:B004/m01`); هدية تطلب المكافأة (`quranic:root_001294:B008/m01`); رُبّ خاثر وإصلاح به (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fruit sheath, camphor, prepared guest provision, grape, gift seeking return, and thick syrup or clarified residue trace produce from protected growth into refined social use.

subchannels.name: Land grant, flock, and contracted labor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Agrarian production is organized through allocated land, herds, and agreed work.
subchannels.active_motifs: إقطاع وإذن واقتطاع (`quranic:root_001240:B013/m01`); قطيع من النعم والغنم (`quranic:root_001240:B016/m01`); مقاطعة على أجر أو عمل (`quranic:root_001240:B024/m01`); الحُسار نبات خاص (`quranic:root_000320:B007/m01`); السعة للذهاب والمعاش (`quranic:root_000666:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Land allotment, flock, wage contract, pasture plant, and movement for livelihood define an agrarian economy. Property and labor are not background categories; they determine who can turn land into provision.

subchannels.name: Field pests, predators, and migratory animals
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cultivated space is shared with small pests, warning birds, raptors, scavengers, and seasonal movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: البعوضة لصغرها وإيذائها (`quranic:root_000133:B002/m01`); طائر جارح يسمى العلام (`quranic:root_001040:B006/m01`); ذكر الضباع يسمى العيلام (`quranic:root_001040:B007/m01`); الواقي اسم للصرد (`quranic:root_001677:B005/m01`); ذهاب الطير ورجوعه بين البلاد (`quranic:root_001240:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mosquito, hawk, male hyena, shrike, and migratory birds make the field an ecological scene rather than a closed human asset. Visibility, warning, predation, and seasonal movement pressure the stability of yield.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Agriculture covers seed, receives rain, raises plant and fruit, protects produce, and allocates land, flock, and labor.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; revelation's descent and the reminder's protective function resonate with rain, seed-cover, and guarded yield.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field includes grapevine, barley, fruit sheath, camphor, pasture plant, mosquito, hawk, hyena, shrike, migratory birds, land grant, and wage contract.

parent_channels.name: P3: Perception and life fail through bodily depletion

subchannels.name: Eye, gaze, and exhausted vision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sight depends on an intact organ, directed attention, and sustained capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: إبصار العين (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); بصيرة القلب (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); الحَسير منقطع القوة (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`); شق ظاهر في الشفة العليا (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Eye-sight, inward sight, exhausted gaze, and split upper lip locate perception in vulnerable bodily structures. Seeing can fail by fatigue or injury even when truth remains present.

subchannels.name: Hair, skin, covering, and shedding
subchannels.scene_or_process: The body's outer layer grows, protects, and is periodically or traumatically lost.
subchannels.active_motifs: الشَّعر النابت وما عليه زغب (`quranic:root_000798:B001/m01`); الحاسر عار من الوقاية (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`); التحسر سقوط الريش والشعر وانضواء اللحم (`quranic:root_000320:B005/m01`); ستر وتغطية (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); سباح الجلود والكساء (`quranic:root_000666:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hair and down, armorless exposure, molting or hair loss, covering, and strong leather clothing turn the body's surface into a changing protective medium.

subchannels.name: Gut contraction, colic, tremor, and high breath
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stress appears as involuntary contraction, abdominal interruption, shaking, and respiratory strain.
subchannels.active_motifs: انقباض الأمعاء من الظمأ (`quranic:root_000297:B008/m01`); مغص وبهر وانقطاع باطن (`quranic:root_001240:B021/m01`); القِلُّ رعدة واضطراب (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); الحَسير منقطع القوة (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`); حر الهاجرة (`quranic:root_001226:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Thirst-contracted intestine, colic and panting, tremor, spent capacity, and midday heat form an escalating failure of internal regulation under pressure.

subchannels.name: Joint, life-artery, seed, and bodily continuity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life persists through articulated support, circulating supply, and reproductive transmission.
subchannels.active_motifs: رأس الفخذ المستدير (`quranic:root_001294:B007/m01`); الوتين عرق الحياة (`quranic:root_001622:B002/m01`); غلظ وتين الإبل (`quranic:root_001622:B005/m01`); ماء الرجل الخارج (`quranic:root_001492:B009/m01`); شاة رُبّى وحداثة (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hip joint, life-artery, thickened vessel, reproductive fluid, and recent birth or youth connect mechanical articulation, circulation, and generation. The fatal cut attacks one conduit in a wider system of bodily continuity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The body registers truth and consequence through eye, skin, hair, gut, breath, circulation, tremor, and fatigue.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:38-39 begins with seeing, and 69:45-46 ends in a precisely fatal bodily intervention.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physiology reaches staring eye, lip split, hair loss, armorless skin, thirst-contracted intestine, high breath, colic, hip socket, semen, and the artery that feeds the liver.

parent_channels.name: P3: Social distance is made spatial

subchannels.name: Clan origin and protected access
subchannels.scene_or_process: Lineage and bodily reputation provide a social enclosure within which a person claims safety.
subchannels.active_motifs: حجز الرجل أصله وعشيرته (`quranic:root_000297:B006/m01`); الحجزة كناية عن العفة (`quranic:root_000297:B007/m01`); ربة وجماعات كثيرة (`quranic:root_000532:B004/m01`); ربابة عهد وميثاق (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); رُبَى حاجة وعقدة ونعمة (`quranic:root_000532:B016/m01`); الأَحَدِيَّة والوَحْدَة (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Clan root, chastity, gathered groups, covenant, tightly knotted need or favor, and singular person describe belonging through recognized origin and obligation. Protection depends on whether the social enclosure remains answerable to its member.

subchannels.name: Separating region, hidden pass, and remote settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distance and terrain regulate who can reach a community or place.
subchannels.active_motifs: الحجاز الفاصل بين البلاد (`quranic:root_000297:B003/m01`); موضع منقطع (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); ثنية مستورة (`quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`); سبوحة الموضع (`quranic:root_000666:B008/m01`); جبل أُحُد (`quranic:root_000017:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hijaz as separator, remote village or grave, hidden mountain pass, sacred location, and Mount Uhud turn social distance into named geography. Place preserves identity while also limiting access.

subchannels.name: Banishment, strandedness, and severed relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person loses entry to patron, route, or kin and is left without a sustaining relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: المُحَسَّر محقر مقصى (`quranic:root_000320:B006/m01`); انقطاع الرجاء والسفر (`quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`); هجر وصريمة وقطع وصل (`quranic:root_001240:B007/m01`); تبرؤ وتنصل (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); الانفراد والتفرق آحادا (`quranic:root_000017:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Exclusion from royal doors, stranded traveler, severed relation, disavowal, and isolated individuals describe social death as loss of passage and sponsor.

subchannels.name: Secluded woman, guarded boundary, and controlled meeting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protection is achieved by regulating visibility and access to a person.
subchannels.active_motifs: صون الجارية وخدرها (`quranic:root_001696:B002/m01`); دفع الضرر بوقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); جعل النفس في وقاية (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); الحجزة كناية عن العفة (`quranic:root_000297:B007/m01`); هدنة قسامة (`quranic:root_001226:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Secluded protected woman, barrier, self-guarding, chastity, and truce define safety through controlled encounter. The scene is relational: it specifies who may approach and under what peace.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Exclusion, kinship, refuge, remoteness, and individual separation are expressed through geography and controlled access.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 69:47's 'anyone among you' and 69:49's division within the audience activate the social field.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field reaches clan-origin, Hijaz as separator, remote village or grave, mountain pass, banishment from court, stranded stranger, secluded woman, and holy valley.

parent_channels.name: S1. Lot vessel, draw, and assigned share
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Lots are gathered in a dedicated hide or vessel, one is drawn among participants, and the result isolates an assigned share.
parent_channels.active_motifs: وعاء يجمع سهام الميسر (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); اقتراع يخرج السهم بين الشركاء (`quranic:root_001219:B004/m01`); إفراز النصيب وتقسيم الشيء (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Vessel, lots, draw, and apportioned result close one allocation scene. It materializes the visibly divided outcomes of 69:19 and 69:25, while usefully pressuring that primary reading by contrast: the lexical practice uses chance, but the Surah presents the handed result as certain judgment rather than a lucky draw.

parent_channels.name: S2. Tipcat bat, strike, and audible impact
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wooden bat strikes the qilla and produces both a physical mark and a heard impact.
parent_channels.active_motifs: خشبة القال التي تضرب بها القلة (`quranic:root_001272:B008/m01`); قرع شيء وضربه بآلة (`quranic:root_001219:B001/m01`); أثر الضرب وصوت الوقوع (`quranic:root_001675:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Bat, target, blow, impact trace, and sound form a complete game-stroke. The scene reframes the striking calamity of 69:4 through a controlled miniature collision: the same strike schema can be bounded play, whereas the Surah enlarges it into an event no player can contain or reverse.

parent_channels.name: S3. Adhan, listening, standing, and response
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A caller announces prayer from an audible place; a hearer listens and accepts, stands to pray, answers the summons, and seals supplication with amen.
parent_channels.active_motifs: الأذان والمؤذن وموضع بلوغ النداء (`quranic:root_000022:B003/m02`); الإصغاء وقبول المسموع (`quranic:root_000022:B002/m01`); القيام في الصلاة أو الذكر (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m02`); الصلاة المفروضة بقيامها وركوعها وسجودها (`quranic:root_000880:B001/m01`); جواب الداعي والتلبية (`quranic:root_001573:B003/m01`); قول آمين طلبا للاستجابة (`quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `ء ذ ن`: 69:12 (أُذُنٌ); `ق و م`: 69:7 (قَوْمَ); `ص ل ي`: 69:31 (صَلُّ); `ه ا ء`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ء م ن`: 69:33 (يُؤْمِنُ), 69:41 (تُؤْمِنُ)
parent_channels.synthesis: Caller, audible range, receptive hearer, standing body, prayer, answering voice, and amen close a congregational rite. It supports 69:12 by making the remembering ear an obedient response mechanism, and it reframes the glorification of 69:52 as an embodied communal answer rather than reception that stops at hearing.

parent_channels.name: S4. Gestation, labor opening, and midwife reception
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fetus is gathered and carried internally until labor approaches, the lower back opens, and a midwife receives the emerging child.
parent_channels.active_motifs: الحمل في بطن المرأة أو الناقة (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m01`); قرب النتاج (`quranic:root_000493:B004/m01`); رحم يجمع دما أو جنينا (`quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`); انفراج الصلا عند الولادة ووقوع الولد (`quranic:root_000880:B006/m02`); القابلة تتلقى الولد عند الولادة (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Interior gathering, gestation, approaching labor, bodily opening, emergence, and receiving hands form a complete birth scene. It materializes the Surah's movement from what is concealed at 69:18 to an outcome placed in the hand at 69:19 or 69:25: what develops unseen becomes unavoidable and publicly received.

parent_channels.name: S5. Washing, shrouding, right-side placement, and burial
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A body is washed, wrapped and placed in a grave on its right side, commended in prayer, and covered with earth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: غسل البدن وإزالة الدرن (`quranic:root_001087:B001/m02`); الكفن والقبر ومواراة الميت (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`); توسيد الميت على يمينه (`quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`); الدعاء للغير بالرحمة والاستغفار (`quranic:root_000880:B002/m01`); إهالة التراب على الميت ودفنه (`quranic:root_000482:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Washing, shroud, grave, right-side placement, prayer, and heaped soil close a burial rite. It reframes the exposure of 69:18 and the failed intervention of 69:47: burial closes and covers a body through communal care, while final presentation reopens concealment and leaves the account beyond human shielding.

parent_channels.name: S6. Metered poem as sung ensemble
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A poet composes divided meter, then a singer, answering partner, and stringed instrument turn the verbal craft into a performed piece.
parent_channels.active_motifs: قريض موزون وصناعة شاعر (`quranic:root_000798:B007/m01`); تقطيع البيت إلى أجزاء العروض (`quranic:root_001240:B022/m01`); الغناء بالصوت والتطريب (`quranic:root_001110:B003/m01`); المراسل في الغناء (`quranic:root_000563:B008/m02`); العود المزهر الذي يضرب عليه (`quranic:root_001058:B010/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Composition, segmented meter, lead voice, answering performer, and instrument form a complete human production chain. The ensemble sharpens the denial at 69:41: "not a poet's word" excludes not merely a title but an authored, measured, and performed system, so revelation's acoustic force cannot be reduced to that craft.

parent_channels.name: S7. Slaughter, skinning, roasting, and eating
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A blade stills a slaughtered animal, the hide is removed, flesh is divided and roasted, and the result is eaten.
parent_channels.active_motifs: السكين التي تسكن اضطراب المذبوح (`quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`); إبقاء السالخ لحما أو شحما في الإهاب (`quranic:root_001102:B012/m01`); الصرم والإبانة الحسية (`quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`); شوي اللحم بالنار (`quranic:root_000880:B004/m02`); تناول المطعوم (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Knife, skinning trace, division, roasting, and eating close a butchery-to-meal process. It usefully pressures 69:30-37: ordinary processing produces nourishment for a living community, but the punitive sequence immobilizes a body and culminates in contaminating non-food, placing the condemned on the processed rather than the nourished side.

parent_channels.name: S8. Postpartum brazier, hot water, and washing station
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A postpartum woman sits over a brazier or heated pit for an ailment, with hot water and a prepared bathing place completing the treatment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: جلوس النفساء على المجمر أو في حفيرة موقدة من داء (`quranic:root_000450:B006/m01`); الماء الحار والاغتسال به (`quranic:root_000001:B002/m01`); موضع الاغتسال وآلة التسخين (`quranic:root_000001:B013/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Patient, heat source, hot medium, and washing station close a specific therapeutic practice. It reframes 69:31-36 by inversion: fire, heated water, and washing ordinarily aim at recovery and cleansing, whereas the punishment field turns them into exposure without cure or purification.

parent_channels.name: S9. Foster calf, protected udder, and timed milk yield
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A dam separated from her calf is induced to accept another young animal; access to the udder is controlled, milk is allowed to return, and repeated milking sustains the household supply.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ناقة نحي ولدها وتعطف على حوار غيرها لتدر (`quranic:root_000436:B010/m01`); شاة قريبة العهد بالولادة ملازمة للبيت للبن (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); الشمال المشدود على ضرع الشاة (`quranic:root_000819:B004/m01`); رجوع اللبن في الضرع بين الحلبتين (`quranic:root_001188:B006/m01`); اللبن والدر المتتابع (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Foster transfer, recent birth, protected access, replenishment interval, and repeated yield form a complete lactation practice.
