It materializes the failure in 69:34 to encourage feeding the poor: provision depends on substituted care, restraint, waiting, and collection, not on passive possession of an animal or resource.

parent_channels.name: S10. Arrow nock, point, and defective flight
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An arrow is fitted to the string at its nock and supplied with a point; point shape, a broken nock, or absent feathers determines its working form and trajectory.
parent_channels.active_motifs: فوق السهم ومشق رأسه وموضع الوتر (`quranic:root_001188:B009/m01`); السلوف الطويل من نصال السهام (`quranic:root_000733:B014/m01`); المعراض السهم الذي يمضي عرضا أو بلا ريش (`quranic:root_001001:B013/m02`); النصل القصير العريض أو السهم المقطوع (`quranic:root_001240:B014/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Nock, string, point, feathers, and trajectory form a complete projectile mechanism. It reframes the alignment of saying, messenger, and source in 69:40-44, while making the precise cut of 69:45-46 concrete: a broken nock or unfeathered shaft travels awry, whereas fitted parts carry directed force.

parent_channels.name: X1. P1 -> P2 -> P3: Seizure narrows its target
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The same superior taking first overtakes a disobedient people, then arrests and collars one condemned person, and finally threatens a putative fabricating messenger with a precise severing of the lifeline.
parent_channels.active_motifs: حوز الشيء وتناوله (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); المؤاخذة بالذنب (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); القبض والأسر (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); طوق يغل العضو (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); الصرم والإبانة (`quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`); الوتين عرق الحياة (`quranic:root_001622:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: `ء خ ذ` is the only surface operation repeated in all three pericopes. Its target contracts from the historical collective in P1, to the judged individual in P2, to the hypothetical false carrier in P3; its endpoint likewise sharpens from overwhelming capture, to fixed restraint, to a cut at the life-artery. The progression joins historical judgment, eschatological sentence, and revelation-authentication under one rule of answerability.

parent_channels.name: X2. P1 -> P2 -> P3: A heard warning becomes a readable account
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A messenger carries a warning to an ear that may accept and retain it; the receiver's response later appears as a written record read aloud, while the closing pericope identifies the saying's carrier, renews the reminder, and names continued denial.
parent_channels.active_motifs: الرسول والرسالة (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); الإصغاء وقبول المسموع (`quranic:root_000022:B002/m01`); ضم المعنى في القلب (`quranic:root_001664:B001/m01`); نظم الحروف واسم المكتوب (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); قراءة وتلاوة وإقراء (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); الذكرى والتذكرة ما يذكّر (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); خلاف الصدق (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: P1 supplies the carrier, receptive organ, and retained reminder; P2 externalizes response as a personal text placed before readers; P3 certifies the carrier and source while dividing remembrance from denial. The bridge is causal rather than topical: hearing becomes accountable reception, reception becomes record, and the record's verdict preserves the original relation to the message.

parent_channels.name: X3. P1 -> P2: Punishment changes from measured duration to measured reach
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Seven marks the duration for which a destructive environment encloses a people, while seventy cubits marks the spatial reach of the chain that encloses one body.
parent_channels.active_motifs: العدد سبعة وما يتفرع منه (`quranic:root_000669:B001/m01`); القياس بالذراع (`quranic:root_000512:B002/m01`); الذرع طاقة ومدى (`quranic:root_000512:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated numerical stem converts temporal exposure in P1 into spatial restraint in P2. Seven nights exceed communal endurance; seventy body-derived units exceed individual reach and capacity. Measurement therefore performs the same scene twice at different scales, giving historical storm and eschatological chain a common boundary of inescapability.

parent_channels.name: X4. P1 -> P2 -> P3: Inquiry becomes wished ignorance and then certainty
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The opening asks what could make the hearer know the binding reality; the right-hand recipient anticipates the account from signs, the left-hand recipient wishes not to know it, and the close resolves the movement as fixed truth and certainty.
parent_channels.active_motifs: الدراية والعلم (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); يقين بعد أمارة (`quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`); العد والحساب (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); ثبات مطابق للواقع ضد الباطل (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); ثبات العلم وزوال الشك (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated `د ر ي` reverses the knower's stance: P1 opens an epistemic gap, whereas P2 makes the condemned wish that gap had never closed. The vindicated person's sign-based conviction supplies the positive middle path, and P3 joins the opening `ح ق ق` frame to `ي ق ن`, ending inquiry in knowledge that can no longer be deferred or refused.

parent_channels.name: X5. P1 -> P2 -> P3: Effective carriage gives way to failed human protection
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 preserves a vulnerable collective by carrying it through the flood; P2 removes the intimate person who might remain near the condemned; P3 denies that anyone can interpose as a barrier against enforcement.
parent_channels.active_motifs: إقلال المحمول الظاهر (`quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`); الحميم والحامة في القربى (`quranic:root_000001:B011/m01`); الحيلولة بفاصل (`quranic:root_000297:B001/m01`); استغراق النفي (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Protection changes role across the Surah: authorized carriage succeeds in P1, ordinary social proximity is absent in P2, and attempted intervention is universally negated in P3. The contrast distinguishes preservation granted by the governing agent from kinship or obstruction imagined as independent shields, progressively stripping the condemned of substitute protection.
